tei:div.tei:p: ༄7ོ/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa gzhung brgya smra ba'i seng ge siji'i mtshan can gyine rnam par thar pathuyon tan gyi rgya mtsho la dad pa'i za rlabs rnam par g.yo ba zhes bya ba ba4/gas so/ /byams pa lha btsun grags pasisgom da/— shang3keng thon mā dpo sgrun khang gis bskrun/

rtsom zig pa / phun tshogs bzang po/lus dag pa/ mkhan kun bzang rgyal mtshan/dge legs/rtsis 'khor ba/ zla ba sgrol ma/paṇa chen gzhung brgya pa'i rnam thar/lha btsun grags pas brtsams/shang kang then mā dpe bskrun khang gis bskrun/kre cang than tā par khang gis par du btab/deb tshad/ ho smris 850྾ho smis1168 1mo 32 dpar shog 7 5 yig grangs khri/ 6 52005lo'i zla bcu gcig par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs shing par thengs dang po par/rin gong sgor/ 8 00

sngon 'gro 'i lu mchid/ gzhung —ba—rgya smra ba'i song ge dngos grub dpal 'bar mchog ni spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i nang byon pa'i sa skya pa'i mkhas dbang grags can zhig yin par ma zad/ gzhung lugs mi 'dra ba brgya lhag tsam la stan thog gcig tu dam bca' mdzad pa'i bod kyi panita chen po zhig4 kyang yin rkyen/ / gzhung brgya smra bu'i seng ge zhes pa'i mtshan gyi cod paṇa yang gsol bas na/ sngar phan khong gi rna4 par thar pa tshigs bcad lhug sna tshogs pa mang du yod 'dug kyang bar skabs dus 'gyur gyi rkyen pas ha lam ming gi lhag ma tsam du gyur zin kyang / nye sngon dpal sa skya'i dpe mdzod khad nas khong gi dngos slob lha btsun grags pas mdzad pa'i yig cha 'di rnyed son byung bar brten/ ma dpe nga/ra ma ches spus zhan zhig yin pas yig nor du dogs pa'i go ba lon mi nāb pa'i tshig 'bru mi nyung ba zhig ldan la/ bar bar nas shog lte kha shas rtsa ba nas chad kyang 'dug mod/ dpe gzhan lag son ma thub pa'i dbang gi mngon tshan che ba'i yig nor 'ga' re bcos pa phud kha skong sogs kyi spros pa skyungs te/ re zhig dpe rgyun chad par dogs pa'i lhag bsam 1

gyis kun nas blangs te bsgrigs spel zhus yod pa'i thad mkhan chen kun bzang rgyal mtshan mchog dang / dge legs lags sogs kyi zhus dag thengs mang gnang ba sogs bka' drin chen po bskyangs pa dang /dpal sa skya'i dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe g.yar po gnang ba/ de bzhin rang dgon gyi sku zhabs lhan rgyas dang / par bsgrun thad rogs dngul gnang mkhan sogs snga phyir bka' drin che ba'i bshes gnyen dang grogs mchog lhan rgyas la'ang go skabs 'di dang bstun nas bka' drin legs gsol zhu rgyu dang chabs cig slad nas rnam thar 'di'i ma dpe cha tshang ba dag phyag son byungardzitshe phran la cis kyang zhogs 'degs gnang rgyu'i skyabs 'jug zhu rgyu ces bsgrigs spel ba'i ming tsam 'dzin pa phun tshogs bzang pos/2005 lor dpal sa skya'i nye 'dab chos 'khor lhun po nas/2

dkar chagamachod par brjod cing brtsam par dam bca' ba (1)dang po rgyal ba bong ma rnams kyi rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin nga la 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i sprul sku mchog tu lung bstan pa'i mdzad pa/ (5)ga/nyis pa 'gro ba kun gyis bkur gnas su gyur pa'i—phyir rigs rus phun sum tshogs par sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa/ (12)gsum pa yon tan kun gyi bzhi bzung ba'i slad du bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshul khrims ji ltar no sa pa'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi mdzad pa/ (14)bzhi pa skyes bu dam pa rnams dang mthun par rang smin cing gzhan rjes su bzung ba'i slad du bshes gnyen dam pa bsten nas bka' dang dgongarme 'grel gyi bstan bcos la legs par sbyangs tshul bstan pa'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi mdzad pa/ (19)ṭ+wāṃ

lnga pa mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pas rgya chen mkhas pa'i dbang po'i go 'phang brnyes pa'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi mdzad pa/ ( 39)drug pa zab lam la gnad du bsnun pas grub pa brnyes pa'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi mdzad pa/ rdzi (48)bdun pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa sngon du song ba la brten nas/'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa phyogs bcur spel ba'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi mdzad pa/ (64)brgyad pa rtag 'dzin zlog phyir sku 'pho ba bstan te/ slar yang gdul bya'i bsam pa dang mthun par mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan nas bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi mdzad pa/ (85)4

mchod par brjod cing brtsam par dam bca' ba/༄sha /na mo ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta bha ḍa sargyo ru mi tri sirnyi shrī dz+wa la ya/mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i sku/ /don gnyis mthar phyin rdo rje gsum gyi dngos/ /lhun grub sku bzhi ye shes lnga yi bdag /rdo rje 'dzin dbang dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rgya chen shes bya'i lha lam yangs par mos dge'i rta ljang gis drangs mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor gzi 'od 'bar/ /lta ngan gza' bral 'pho ba'i thibs bcom thugs rje'i zer mdangs gang blo'i char rgyun 'dab phreng bzhad mdzad de/ /tshogs pas rkyen bzhin rnam grol snying po sbyin mdzad 'gag med sgyu ma'i rgyud 'chang lan brgyar g.yo ba can/ /gang gi zhabs zung gser gyi 'khor lo'i mdab bkra lhar bcas skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan nor bu'i rtag tu mchod/ /ro 'dzin brgya ldan sim sged kyi/ /phrin las thigs pa nyer blangs shing / /snyan grags rgya chen rgyun phab kyang / /yon tan chu gter mi zad pa/ /blo gros snyim pas rab drangs nas/ /dad ldan gdung ba sel byed cing / /rnam dpyod lang mtsho'i ljon pa las/ /bskyod pa'i dri bsung 'di na 'tshor/ /'dir dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phan bde'i phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ gdul bya yongs kyi don du theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes banyen du sprul pashā ni/ zab rgyas zung du 'jug pa'i chos kyi sku'i lha lam rab tu yangs par gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor — 1 —

legs par shar te/ mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'bar bas/shes bya'i dngos po ma lus pa gsal bar khyab cing / mtha' yas pa'i sems can gyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas/ gnas skabs rnam byang gi rgyu lam dag gi bde ba la bkod nas/ mtharetho thug 'bras bu dbang phyug brgyad ldan tshe 'diji nyid la stsol bar mdzad pa'i bdag nyid chen po/bstan pa rin po che'i srid mtha' dag la mnga' mdzad nas/ bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i khrims gnyis kyi mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas thub pa'i dbang po'i lung rtogs kyi rgyal sa mdzes par byed pa'i chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po mthar 'dzin gyi lta ba ngan pa'i cong rong du blo gros kyi lus stobs rab tu hū+oṃ nga ba rnams la brtse ba chen po'i spyan gyis gzigs te/ rnam dag grub mtha' bzhi'i them skas la brten nas mtha' gnyis bral ba'i dbu ma rin po che'i khang bzang phun sum tshogs par dkris te yon tan gyi nor bu mtha' yas pa'i dpal la 'god pa'i sa mkhan bla na med pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa rgya che zhing shugs drag pas/ rnam dkar gyi bag chags med pa'i gdul bya rnams kyis kyang mtshan thos pa'am gdams pa btab pa'i mod la byang chub kyi myu gu phun sum tshogs pa skrun nus pa/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi mdud pa rang sar grol te/ thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba la bsgrin zhing 'grus pas mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan phul du phyin pa rnyed phyir/khams gsum gyi 'gro ba kun gyi gtsug rgyan nor bus btud de lha mir bcas pa'i skye dgu yongs kyi mgon skyabs dam par lham me lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs pa/ rig pa dang grol bar smra ba'i spobs pas rgyal ba'i — 2 —

chos tshul rgyas pa la snyel ba mi mnga' bas/ mtha' yas pa'i gdul bya'i ma rtogs pa dang / the tshom gyi dri ma mtha' dag sel ba'i ye shes la dbang 'byor ba/ rang dang gzhan gyi spub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol du byon pas/ sgrub pa dang sun 'byin pa'i cha la mi shes pa'i mun pa 'a thib po bsal nas chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa la ('di nas ma dper shosmo grangs sanyis chad ) pa'i yon tan rnams sgro bkur spangs te bshad par bya ba la skyon yod pa ma yin no/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir rnam par thar pasnayon tan gyi rgya mtsho la dad pa'i rba rlabs rnam par g.yo ba zhes bya ba 'di 'chad pa la/ rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag /brtsam pa'i rnam par thar pa dngos/ 'bras bu khyad par myon 'grub pa'i ched du smon lam gdab pa'o/ /dang po la/ de lta bu rtsom pa'i bar chad zhi ba'i ched du mchod par brjod pa dang / brtsam pa mthar phyin par bya ba'i ched du dam bca' ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dbyer ma mchis pa la sgo gsum gus pas phyas 'tshal lo/ /phun sum tshogs pa gangs can ljong35 kyi yul/ / zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis nga/ brtsamakyipar dam bca' ba ni/ rgyal ba khyod kyi yon tan rgya mtsho la/ /zhes pa la soklos pa'o/ /de'irtedon nin rje btsu na chen poḥde'i rnam par thar pa'i yo na tan rgya mtsho lta bu zab cing be+etha' dpag par dka' ba la/ bu chen mkhas 'grub grangs mang ba rnam dpyod kyi lus stobs rab tu rgyas shing / mkhyen brtse'i gshog yangs can rnams rtse dga' rol zhing rgyu ba ni shin tu legs par zad mod༈ — 4 'on rkyang ngang pa'i ded dpon la ltos na chu skyar’gyi tshogs phusaganyabs’dang gshog rtsal zhan yang — 3 ——

chu mtsho la rtse zhing rol ba gzhan gyis zlog mi nus pa bzhin/ bdag kyang rnam dpyod kyi lus stobs rab tu rgyas pa med mod/ 'on kyang rang nyid kyis ji tsam mthong ba'i yon tan 4rnams brjod pa la spro ba skyes shing bshad par dam 'cha' ba'o/ /zhes bya ba yin no/ /gnyis pa brtsam pa'i rnam par thar pa dngos la/ bstan pa'i rim pa dang sbyar ba'i sgo nas lus mdor bstan pa dang / mdzad pa'i rim pa dang sbyar ba'i sgo nas yan lag rgyas par bshad pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ lung bstan blta mas dang khrims nos legs par sbyangs/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa mdzad pa'i rims pa dang sbyar ba'i sgo nas yan lag rgyas par bshad pa la/ rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyi rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin pa la 'gran pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i sprul sku mchog tu lung bstan pa'i mdzad pa/ 'gro ba kun gyi bkur ga/nas su gyur pa'i phyir rigs rus phun sum tshogs par sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa/ yon tan kun gyi gzhi bzung ba'i slad du bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshul khrims ji ltar nod pa'i mdzad pa/ skyes bu dam pa rnams dang mthun par rang smin cing gzhan rjes su bzung ba'i slad du bshes gnyen du ma bsten nas bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos la legs par sbyangs tshul bstan pa 'i mdzad pa/ mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pas rgya chen mkhas pa'i dbang ngo/'i so 'phang brnyes pa'i mdzad pa/ zab lam rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pas grub pa brnyes pa'i mdzad pa/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa sngon du song ba la brten nas 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa phyogs bcur spel ba'i mdzad pa/ rtag 'dzin ldog — 4 —

phyir sku 'pho ba bstan te slar yang gdul bya'i bsam pa dang mthun par mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas bstan pa yun du gnas pa'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi mdzad pa dang brgyad kyi/ dngacepo rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyi rgyal ba'i 0lhan pa 'dzin pa la 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i sprul sku mchog tu lung bstan pa'i mdzad pa ni/ dngos stobs rigs pas sa gsum 'dar byed pa/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /de yang sku lnga ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo rje btsun paṇa chen 'di nyid/ sbyir gdul bya'i don mdzad tshul ni/ theg pa chen po la sogs pa chos kyi sgo du ma dang / sprul pa du mas 'gro ba rnams 'dren par mdzad pa yin la/ de'ang longs sku'i zhing khams 'og/ min stug po bkod pa'am/ gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhes bya ba yin la/ de'i khong du chud pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi ma/jed de sprul sku'i zhing khams so/ /'di ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams te/ gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya yod cing / rang gnas pa'i gling bzhi 'di ni bcom pa dang ldan nga/'i gling zhes bya ba yin la/ de'i nang nas kyang 'dzam bu'i gling ngo / /'di'i dbus na sprul pa'i sku mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i cha rdo rje'i gdan yod la/ de las byang phyogs su bgrod pa ni bod yul kha ba can gyi ljongs sa'i cha mtho zhing gangs kyi phreng bas yongs su bskor ba/ sprul pa'i lo paṇa dang / rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' du mas rjes su bathung zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'icos phyogs 'dir bstan pa'i gsal byed dam par lung bstan pa ni/ rdo rdze— gur las/ gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin — 5 —

pa zhes/ /de nyid slob dpon tshul bzung ste/ /sems can phan brtags dmigs nas ni/ /tha mal pa yi gzugs su gnas/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ dbang bskur ba'i bla ma la ji ltar lta bar bgyi/ bka' bstsal pa/ slob dpon ston par gyur pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis phyas/ mdzad pa/ /bdag cag rnams kyi pha dang ma/ /'di nyid yin par bsam par bya/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /da lta slob dpon sazugs 'dzin te/ /sems can rjes su bzung don du/ /phal pa'i gzugs su gnas pa'o/ /zhes dang / ba tsha can chu klung gi mdo las/ lnga brgya tha mar gyur pa na/ nga nyid slob dpon gzugs kyis gnas/ /nga'o snyam du yid byos la/ /de tshe de la gus pa bskyed/ /zhes dang / slob dpon birlu pas/ sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje 'chang / /rtsod pa'i dus 'dir bdag don du/ /kun dang mthun par ston mdzad pa/ /de ltar shes nas dngos kun gyi/ /bste bya dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /dngos grub rgya chen snod du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'dren mchog shākya'i rgyal po de nyid gang la gang 'dul gyis dbe/ ba'i bshes gnyen gyi skur sprul nas sems can gyi don mdzad par sasungs pa dang / khyad par sher phyin zab mo'i mdo las/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di nas yul warta nir rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang phyogs nas byang phyogs gdong dmar can gyi yul du rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / lha mo dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi zhus pa'i mdo las/ byang phyogs nas byang phyogs gdong dmar can gyi yul du shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa nyid kyis rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes rgyal ba sangs rgyas nyid kyi sprul pas gdong dmar can — 6 —

gyi yul du snying po don gyi sher phyin dar rgyas su spel bar lung bstan pa ji bzhin gyi dus la bab par dgongs te/ byang phyogs gangs ri'i khrod 'di ru theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du sprul nas sher phyin gyi bstan pa dar rgyas su spel bar gsungs pa de nyid rje btsun paṇa chen la sbyar du rung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni sher phyin gyi lta ba ngo sprod pa la mchog tu gyur pa ni/ rje 'di lta bu da lta gangs ri'i khrod na yo da pa ma/ yin la/ sher phyin yum sras bcu bdun gyi tshig don la blo gros thogs med du rgyas shing thugs zhen lhag par che ba'i rgyu mtshan 'og tu ston no/ /bye brag tu rje btsun paṇa chen 'di nyid 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med shākya seng be'i spyan sngar rgyal ba'i sras po zla 'od gzhon nu zhes bya ba phyis gangs ri'i khrod 'dir dge slong 'tsho byed ces bya bar sku skye ba bzhes te/ snying po don gyi bstan pa dar rgyas su spel bar mdzad/ de'i rjes su shar mdo khams kyi yul du rje btsun kun dga' rin chen zhes yongs su grags pa'i mkhas grub chen po mngon par shes pa thogs med du smra ba der skye ba bzhes te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spel bar mdzad pa yin la/ slar yang gtsang stod kyi sa'i char sku'i skye ba bzhes te/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag la legs par sbyangs shing /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i gnas chen la stod rgyal gyi shrī bsam gtan gling la sogs pa dgon che chung mtha' yas pa zhig gi mkhan po bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag tu mnga' gasgordzo+onganas sa bka' rgyud kyi grub mtha' la brten nas sangs rgyas bstan zasa'i rgya 9khri macakhrid legs par btsugs te/ de'i skye ba phyi ma la gzhartswaphan gyi bran las nam mkha' — 7 —

dang mnyam pa 'byung ngo zhes pa'i lung bstan rje btsun kun dga' rin chen gyi rnam thar la brten nas 'byung ba ni/ rje paṇa chen gyi thugs kyi sras mchog dam par gyur pa gling gi bdag po chen po rgya chen chos kyi spyan ldan ting 'dzin 'od zer ba zhes nyi zla ltar grags pa de nyid las byung ba yin no/ /de'ang ji skad du/ snying rje pad ma dkar po las/kun dga' bo nga 'das nas ma 'ongs pa'i dus na byang phyogs kyi rgyud du dge slong 'tsho byed ces bya ba sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba byas pa/ sangs rgyas brgya stong mang po la bsnyen bkur ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ lhag pa'i bsam/ rnga bskyed nga// thes pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa/ skye bo mang ngo/ la phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir zhugs pa/mang du thos pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod 'dzin pa/ theg pa chen po'i bsngags pa brjod pa/ theg pa chen po yang dag par rab tu ston pa zhig 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes dang mdo sde gdams ngag 'bogs pa'i rgyal po bstan pa dang snyig 'byed pa'i le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa las/nga ni mya ngan 'das nas ni/ /lo ni sum stong nye ba na/ /byang phyogs kha ba can zhes par/ /sems bskyed zla 'od sa/zhon nu 'dir/ /dwasas zhes bya ba'i sa phyogs su/ /'tsho byed ces pa'i bsam/ gtan pa/ /de la 'khor ni lnga brgya 'byung / /thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i rigs/ /de nas 'phos te shar phyogs su/ /lha ldan zhes bya'i 'jig rten du/ /me tog zla mdzes zhes bya yi/ /mtshan dang ldan pa'i rgyal bar 'gyur/ /zhing der bud med mi 'byung ste/ /thams cad pad ma las ni skye/ /de la dad pa de ru skye/ /de ni skyes bu khyad par can/ /zhes lung bstan to/ 'o na — 8 —

lung de dag gis zla 'od gzhon nu'i rgyal ba la thugs bskyed pa dang /dwags po lha rje zla 'od sazhon nu'i skye ba yin pa dang / lha ldan zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams su de bzhin gshegs pa me tog zla mdzes su lung bstan mod kyis/ rje paṇa chen 'di nyid dwags po lha rje'i skye ba yin par gang las bstan zhe na/ bod gangs can gyi grub thob brgyud pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras pa'i rnam par sprul pa chos sku he ru ka chen po gtsang smyon sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis lung bstan pa yin te/ rje btsun ga/tsang pa dbus kyi zal mo brag na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rje paṇa chen 'di nyid kyi zab chos sngar ma gsan pa'i lhag ma rnames zhu ba dang / zhabs rdul gtsug gis len pa la phebs dus/ sku drung du ma phebs tsam la da lta 'byon shing yod pa'i lo rgyus pho nya btang bas/ pho nya bas kyang rje gtsang pa'i drung du phyin/ gong ltar gyi lo rgyus zhus pas thugs dges te/ 'o nga'i bu dbus pa ston pa 'byon pa la bsu ba legs par byed dgos pas khyod shangs pa ring mos spos sna khyer rgyang ring bar song la gdan 'dren zhus la shog /nged rang rnams kyang 'dir bzhugs/ gdan legs par 'chos/rnyed bkur la sogs pa'i grabs gyis gsungs/ de'i tshe shangs pa ring mo brel ba 'ga' zhig gis g.yengs/ de 'phral 'gro ba ma byung ba la rje paṇa chen gyi phebs pas/ de ka'idz+wamod la rje ga/tsang pa nyid sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol/ dbu la rin po 'i dbu rgyan sasol ba sogs mdzad/ te ru ka'i chas su zhugs nas/ ḍargya spos shib phyas tu bsnams nas sgo nang nas bsu ba mdzad pa'i tshe/ — rma4skyas sems can kun gyi — 9 —

mabon gyur cing / /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gsungs te/ 'di slob ma spyan 'dren pa'i tshig yin/ 'o skol skye ba snga ma nas kyi dpon slob yin pas sems shin tu dga' ba cig byung / kho shangs pa ring mo la spyan 'dren la song byas pas ma song 'dug /da bu dbus pa ston pa la pha yis bsu ba byed pa yin pas phebs nas gdan la bzhugs par mdzod/ ces bya ba la sogs pa thugs dges spro 'ba' zhig si ngang nas zab chos rnams legs par gnang bar mdzad do/ /ba/zhan yang dpon slob nang phan tshun shin du thugs dges phyir rje pa/ṇa chen gyi gang zhus ltar rje gtsang pas gnang ba zhig yod/ de stobs kyi rje'i rnam thar cig ci nas kyang brtsam dgos zhes bu slob rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor rje sa/tsang pa rang la bka' gnang zhus/ rnam thar gyi rtsa tshis de yang de dus mdzad pa yin gsung / yang skabs 'ag/'a zhig tu/ zab chos rnams gnang tshar ba'i rjes su/ rje nyid kyi gzigs dpe snyan rgyud kyi po ti legs pa zhig /maṇ+ḍal bzang po zhig gi steng du tshom bu legs par bkod pa/ dkar me zhig spar ba rnams kyis thog drangs gnang sbyin bzang bar mdzad nas/ 'o pha chos bu la 'phrod pa yin pas sems shin tu dga'/ khur khyer sangs rgyas kyi bstan par bsam nas gzhan phan byed dgos pa yin legs po yang yong ba yin no zhes pa la sogs pa'i lung bstan rgyas par mdzad do/ /'o na rje gtsang pa mi la ras pa'i sprul pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ rje gtsang pa rang gi zhal mnga' nas sku mya ngan las 'da' khar gsung byon pa ni/ da mal gyi tha ma 'da' kha'i bkod pa mang po byas nas dgos pa med/ kha la nyan na — 10 —

thams cad tshe dang skrub pa snyom/ ngar ma zad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa yin/ grwa bu slob yon bdag dang bcas pa rnams snyigs dus mi la ras pa dang dngos su mjal ba yin pas las dang skal ba bzang / da dung mi la'i rnam thar la ltos la tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms par gyis dang dngos su gsung thos par 'gyur zhing rjes su 'dzin no/ /chos nyid ngang nas bkod pa e waṃ zhes bka' bstsal to/ /rje gtsang pa la tshad mar mi byed do snyam du sems na/ de ni shin du mi rigs te/ rje gtsang pa 'di 'khrungs nas zla ba dgu song ba'i tshes bcu'i nyinadze+e/ o rgyan pad mas yum la stag tshal phyi rol nang rol nas nga'i sprul pa sprel lo pa cig yong ba yod de'i lus kyi grib ma phog pa tshun thar lam thob pa yod/ sprel sna bya yis drangs na 'dzam gling 'od kyis 'gengs/ zhes lung bstan pa dang /gter bton pad ma gling pas ston pa'i ma 'ongs lung bstan lasalha lcam man ti bzang mos zhus pa/ bde skyid slob dpon rnam grol bzang po midi/ /ma 'ongs dus su ji 'dra'i rigs su 'gyur/ /zhes zhus pas gu ru'i zhal nas/ da lta'i dus kyi rnam grol bzang po 'di/ /'di nas skye ba bcu bdun 'das pa'i mthar/ /gtsang gistong stod mkhar kha zhes bya ru/ /nyang gi rigs 'dzin chu pho the sa'odipa/ khogyis sbom sna nyag mig gnyis 'bru tshugs lta/ /snang ba 'ur —zhija 'dod blo gting nas zhig /smon pa'i mtshan 'chang rtul zhugs3yid palosgos/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir gdul bya 'gro ba 'dren/ /gyag chen chos drug sgron ma sbor bar byeng / /bzhi bcu'i steng na byang chub thems dang ldan/ /ti se la sosas 11 —

sgrub gnas bdun kyang 'dzin/ /sbyin bdag gcig gi chags sdang blang ba'i mthus/ /lnga bcu nga bgrang bar chad 'byung yang srid/ /de las bar chad byung bar ma gyur bar/ /nga yi thugs sras bde gling de nyid dang / /rten 'brel 'grig par gyur na brgyad bcu bzhugs/ /de nas pad ma'i drung du rigs 'dzin sa la bzhugs/ /zhes so/ /de'ang thugs kyi sras pad ma gling pa dngartsorten 'brel ma 'grig pa la brten/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga drug pa la mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa lags so/ /gzhan yang chos rje zla ba grags pa zhes bya ba'i dge bshes bzang po gcig la stod lho'i khyung rtse zhes bya ba'i rgyal sa de na bzhugs pa'i tshe /nub cig mnal lam du/ sang dwags po lha rje phebs yong bas byin rlabs zhus zer ba cig byung / de'i sang su 'byon na snyam tsa na/ paṇa chen 'di nyid khyung rtse zam pa la byon byung bas shin tu spro nas byin rlabs zhus pa yin zhes gsung ba thos so/ /de'ang gong du bstan pa'i lung bstan rnams 'gal bar ni mi bsam ste/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / bye brag tu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lugs kyi gang ('di nas yang ma dper shos grangs sacis chad/) gnyis pa 'gro ba kun gyis bkur gnas su gyur pa'i phyir rigs rus phun sum tshogs par sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa ni/ (sa bcad 'di'i dbu nas cung zad ma tshang ba bong sasal ma dpe chad pa'i khongs su tshud yod) te/ mnga' gnas mthu yi de la ni/ /phun tshogs dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas dang / /lus sems bdud rtsi 'thung bzhin sim/ /'di dag phun tshogs 'dren pa bzhin/ /de nas yum bde ba'i khyad par dang bcas pa'i ngang nas/ /'dzin byed ces bya — 1 2 —

ba me pho byi ba'i lo la bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma dang ldan par sku 'khrungs pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba rgyal rigs dang / /bram ze'i rigs las gzhan mi srid/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid can 'di yang / /mtho dang gtsang ba'i rigs su 'khrungs/ /dus de nyid nas yab yum dpal 'byor je mthor gyur pa yin zhes thos so/ /de mthun pa'i spyod lam gyis bskyangs pas/ pad ljon ltar bskyed dras cing / sku na phra mo'i dus nyid nas rang bzhin gyi dbang po rno ba/ sbyin pa dang / dul ba dang /sdom pa dang / nges pa dang ldan la/ khong 'dzangs shing ya rabs pas/gzhan sems bsrung ba la rab tu brtson paṃ/ blang dor gyi sanas rab tu phyed pas spang blang ma 'dzol bar mdzad cing / rnam byang gi bag chas/sa sad pas/ dkon mchog gi rten gsum/ dang / yab yum la lhag par gus pha/ sku rtsed la sogos pa'ang / dam pa'i chos bshad nyan dang / sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs tshul kho na mdzad pa cig byung ngo / /rje nyid kyi yum 'di ye shes kyi mkha'arī 'a gro'i mtshan dang ldan phyir bsngags pa yang mdzad de/ yum 'dis rje 'di nyid chos sgor 'jug pa'i mthun rkyen mdzad/ grwa sa la thugs gnyer la ma byon gong du sku 'das pa yin la/ 'da' khar yang ma dag pa'i snang ba sogs 'gags te/ dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig shar ba'i rtags su zhal nas/ dar dang za 'og gi dga' ba la a ces sogs dag snang shar ba'i gsung 'ba' zhig 'byon gyin 'dugo/ ste/ de 'dra legs po ratha yin dasgod dro ces bsngags par mdzad do/ /de sngon legs tshogs bsam gyi mi khyab pa bskrun pa'i stobs kyis byad bzang bas skye bo rnams gyi mige la sdug cing / thams cad kyi —— 13 ge

lha bu'i 'du shes nye bar 'jog la mdun gros gyi sbyong tshul la mkhas pas skye bo kun gyi snying la chags par gyur te nyid kyi grags pa phyogs mthar sgrog pa la zhugs/ lta bas mi ngoms 'od dkar can 'di nyid kyi sku la 'gran snyam byed/ /snyan pas tshim bral tshangs pa'i gsung 'di'ang nyid kyi gsung la 'gran par dogs/ /zab cing yangs pa'i chu gter 'di ni nyid kyi thugs la 'gran pa snyam/ /'gro ba'i nad sel chu rgyun 'di ni nyid kyi phrin las mtshon pa'i dpe/ /da ni gsum pa yon tan kun gyi bzhi bzung ba'i slad du bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshul khrims ji ltar nos pa'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi mdzad pa ni/ rgya chen bsod nams rin chen las grub pa'i/ /ces pa la sogs pa'o/ /'di la/ nges 'byung so thar gyi tshul khrims ji ltar nos pa'i tshul/ gzhan phan byang sems gyi tshul khrims ji ltar nos pa'i tshul/ thabs chen rig 'dzin gyi tshul khrims ji ltar nos pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la tshig snga ma dge bsnyen dang / dge tshul gyi sdom pa ji ltar nos pa'i tshul dang / tshig phyi ma bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa nos pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs/ /zhes pa'i don thugs la dgongs ste/ dgung lo dgu bzhes pa'i tshe/ dgon pa shar ri na ṭa'i bla ma rje nyid kyi zhang po dngos grub grags pa dpal bzang po'i drung du byon/ thog mar klog yig la sogs pa ci rigs su sbyangs/ de nas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes pa la mngon du phyogs pa'i tshe/ yab kyi yul gzhis 'dzin dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang bcas chos sgor zhugs na mi 'os pa'i thad bkod byas — 14 —

mthun grub pa ma byung na'ang yum dang slob dmon pa lkog tu bku' bgros nas yum gyi thugs gnyer la snyad slob dpon pa'i drung du rdzong par byas/ de nas slob dpon pas chosasgrosgor 'jug pa'i mgon 'dren gnang bar chad pa ltar dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa phun sum tshogs par bathes shing bar ma rab byung yang nos te/ mtshan dngos grub dpal 'bar zhes gsol lo/ /dus de nyid nas tshul khrims dang / dul ba dang / sdom pa'i dpal la gnas shing btsun pa'i mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ /de nas rig/ gnas kyi gzhi mthar 'don dgos pa rnams dang /nyer 'kho'i thugs sbyong mdzad pa la rje sku mched gnyis/ gzhan grogs kha yar dang bcas slob dpon pa'i drung pru rgyun ring du bzhugs tshe/ rje nyid sku tshe snga ma nas kyi bag chags sad pas bla ma la gus shing sbyangs pa mdzad pa la brtson 'grus mi lhod pas sku rtsed la sogs pa'i rnam pa ci yang ma mdzad do/ /de'i phyir grogasardzo rnams dang spyodalam ma mthun te/ khong rnams kyis mi zug cing yul la 'gro 'dod nas rtsam pa phyags khang du 'bor pa sogs byas pas/ rje nyid thugs shin du 'byung ba dang / khong rnams kyi rtsed mo'i zla la ma byon par thugs sbyong 'ba' zhig mdzad/ gung gseng la yi ge 〉sbyib dgos lags zhus nas bslabs so/ /de'i tshe khong rnams kyi lkog lab byed cing / a jo byung nas phrug gu khyod kyi mi nus pa'i nus nus kyi rin la nged rnams la'ang bka' skyon yong gin 'dug grogs rnams kyis kyang lab kyin 'dug pas khyod gur cig gur cis zer gyin song ngo / /de nas ngas slob dbon pa'i drung du phyin/ bdag cag da yi ge mi 'dri lo gas zhus pas/ de ci yin gsungs ge 15 —

gong gi lo rgyus zhus pas/ pha pha snying re rje/ da khyed rang gi bsam nga dang bstun nas byas chog gi gsungs shin tu brtse bar mdzad do gsung ngo / /de nas zhing 'debs ran pa dang khong rnams yul du zhing las la shog zer byung bas dga' nas song / de rnams med ring la slob gnyer shin du smar bar byung gsungs so/ /dam pa rnams ni yon tan gyi bdud rtsi'i mi ngoms pa'i ngang tshul can dang / 'khor ba'i phun tshogs dang khyim gyi 'byor pa rtsa rtse'i zil pa ltar g.yo zhing mi 'obs kyis spungs pa ltar rig la/ rab tu byung ba'i yon tan gyi dpal byin mthong bas yid phrogs pa ni/ che rigs btsun na nga rgyal stobs kyis snyems/ /khyim gnas 'byor rgud gdung ba 'phel ba'i rgyu/ /bka' thub bde 'byung nags tshal gnas rig nas/ /khyim gyi bde la yid ni chags ma gyur/ /de nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa nos pa'i tshul ni/ dga' bo rab tu byung ba'i mdo las/ byis pa rnams ni me'i 'obs na gnas pa lta bu/rab tu byung ba rnams ni sil ba'i khang pa na gnas pa lta bu'o/ /zhes dang tshul khrims bstan pa'i mdo las/ 'dod pa dag ni rab tu rten byed cing / /bu dang chung ma dag la sred bskyed nas/ /smad par bya ba'i khyim la snyen pa ste/ /bla med byang chub dam pa bzhir ma thob/ /gang dag 'dod pa lci skam me bzhin spong / /bu dang chung ma dag la sred spangs nas/ /khyim gyi skrag te khyim nas sngon 'byung ba/ /de dag byang chub mchog 'di rnyed mi bka'/ zhes pa'i don thugs la dgongs te/ rgyal ba'i zhing khams mi mjed 'jig rten 'dir/ /dri med bstan pa khri gdugs gdal 'dra la/ /dal 'byor lus rnyed rten 'brel phun tshogs — 16 —

dus/ /dad pas ga zhon la rab tu ma byung na/ /ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar lhung na 'gyod ta re/ /gsung zhing dgung lo bcu gsum lon pa'i tshe/bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag mkhas btsun sangs rgyas dar bas mkhan po mdzad/ mkhas pa'i dbang po mkhan chen dpal ldan blo gros pas slob dpon mdzad/ dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su dge tshul gyi sdom pa legs par nos so/ /gnyis pa tshig phyi ma bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa ji ltar nos pa'i tshul ni/ 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i pha rol du phyin pas so so thar pa'i gdugs mchog gi gces spras la dgra bcom pa nye ba 'khor dang 'phags pa rta thul ltar bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba phra mo'i phra mos kyang ma gos par bzhugs pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag byams chen rab 'byam pa sangs rgyas 'phel bas mkhan po mdzad/ 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i dbus na legs bshad kyi phud sgra sgrogs pa'i mkhas grub gdengs can dbang po 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rje kun dga' chos bzang bas las kyi slob dpon/ rje btsun mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug rin chen rnam rgyal bas gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon/ mang du thos pa'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po rab 'byam pa kun dga' 'phel bas grib tshod pa/ mang du thos pa'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po rab 'byams pa bkra shis rin chen sogs kyis las kyi kha skong mdzad de/ dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshangs pa'i dbus su dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun son pa/ dga' byed ces bya ba chu pho stag gi lo sa ga zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshel brtswa lnga sangs rgyas kyi dus chen rnam gsum 'dzom pa'i snga dro'i cha/ grib tshod skyes bu gcig — 17 —

dang / rkang pa gnyis yod pa'i dus su/ tshigs gsum rim gyis nos/bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa legs par bzhes pa yin no/ /dad pa'i dpal ldan da ben pa'i khang bzang na/ /dal 'byor lang tsho tshul khrims rgyan gyis spras/ /tshul bzhin sems pa'i yid 'ong mdza' gros/sa dang / /tshim bral bde spyod de ni khyim pa'am ci/ /gnyis pa gzhan phan byang sems kyi tshul khrims nos pa'i tshul ni/ klu sgrub kyis// bdag dang 'jig rten 'di yis ni/ /bla med byang chub thob 'dod na/ /de yi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan dang / /phyosas mtha' gtugs pa'i snying rje dang / /gnyis la mi brten ye shes lags/ /zhes pa'i don thugs la dgongs te/ snying rje'i chu ba phan bde'i grib bsil can/ /yon tan me tog snyan pa'i dri'i khyab pa/ /rlabs chen spyod pas 'gro rnams srid pa yi/ /tsha gdung skyob la bsgrin zhing lhod mi bya/ /gsung zhing rgya chen mkhas pa'i dbang po kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel ba'i drung du/ shing rta'i srol chen gnyis las 'ongs pa'i sems bskyed dang / khyad par dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed lan bdun gyi bar du gsan cing / gzhan yang 'jam dbyangs chos rje/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ rje rin rnam pa sogs la nos pas srid pa'i bde ba dang rang nyid zhi bar 'dun pa'i smag rum mtha' dgo bsal nas/ nyes spyod las sdom pa dang / dag pa dang / dul ba dang / phan pa dang / bde ba'i dpal la gnas pa ste/ rgya chen spyod pa'i sdong bu rgyas pa dang / //'dab bzang yon tan snying pos dud pa dang / /zhi bde me tog gzhu can nyal ba dang / /phan bde'i dri bsung 'di dag mnyam du byung / /— 18 —

gsum pa thabs chen rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshul khrims ji ltar nos pa'i tshul ni/ gzhan gyi brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang / /bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes pa thugs la dgongs te/ bstan rtsa tshul khrims mig 'bras bzhin du bsrung / /rlabs chen spyod pas gzhan don lhur len cing / /thabs chen rig pa 'dzin pa'i nye rgyu yis/ /nyams len 'di ni gzhan dang thun mong min/ /zhes gsungs zhing / thog mar dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dngos grub grags pa dpal bzang po'i drung du/ tshe dpag med 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dbang / nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang /chos skyong trag shad kyi chos skor rnams gsan/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po la sogs pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i slob dpon du ma la rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dbang lung man ngag mtha' dag nos nas rdo rje theg pa'i brtul zhugs mchog la dbang 'byor bar bzhugs pa yin no/ /da ni bzhi pa skyes bu dam pa rnams dang mthun par rang zin rtsang gzhan rjes su bzung ba'i slad du bshes gnyen dam pa bsten nas bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi bstan brtsas la megs par sbyangs tshul bstan pa'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi ma da pa ne/ tshad med bshes gnyen du ma nyer bsten nas/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /'di la rgyu mtshan nyid theg pa la ji ltar sbyangs pa'i tshul dang / 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa la ji ltar sbyangs pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la 'chad byed dgongs 'brel gyi bstan bcos la ji ltar sbyangs pa'i tshul dang /bshad bya bka' la ji ltar sbyangs pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ dpal ldan — 19 —

bla ma dam pa dngos grub grags pa'i drung du/ 'phral dgos kyi chos spyod lag len gyi skor nye bar mkho ba rnams dang / mtshan nyid kyi gzhung re tsam la gzigs rtog mdzad do/ /de'i tshe slob dpon pa thugs dges phyir gnyen 'khor rnams la bka' lung gnang ba yang / /nga'i 'di la chos cig yong ba yod pas/ khyed rnams kyi gegs ma byed par chas gos la sogs pa'i mthun rkyen byed dgos pa yin gsungasda rtsed mo rang mdzad/ de'i dus su rje 'di nyid/ rgyan las/ sbyor ba'i sngon du snying rje dang / /mos pa dang ni bzod pa dang / /dge ba yang dag spyod pa ni/ /rigs kyi rtags su nges par bshad/ /ces gsungs pa'i don rnams legs par tshang zhing / khyad par du zab mo'i don nyams su bzhes pa la mchog tu gzhol bas/ thugs bsam la/ 'khor ba'i bya ba mtha' dag la snying po mi 'dug pas/ spyir dam pa'i chos kho na dang / khyad par tshe 'di la sgrub pa kho na byed dgos par 'dug /de'ang bal gra gcig gi nang du/ skyi dkar gyi sbung chung rdza se can gcig dang / zhag gsum bzhi tsam 'tsho ba'i rtsam pa/ phor pa chu thub sogs yo byad phran tshegs bcug /de rgyab la bkal te gnas gang bzang du phyin nas tshe dang sgrub pa snyom dgos snyam pa kho na byung gsungs/ 'on kyang thos pa byed pa 'i bag chags bzang ba dang / slob dpon pas kyang bskul ba la brten/ shel dkar chos sder thugs sbyong la byon/ khang gsar bde skyid kyi grwa tshang 'di sman khab pa'i grwa tshang yin pas/ der slob dpon mkhan chen dpal blo ba'i drung du bsnyen/ phar tshad gnyis/ 'jug pa/ dbu ma/shes spring ste bzhi la legs par sbyangs shing / shel dkar chos sder — 20 —

bka' bzhi'i grwa skor mdzad pa'i tshe/ dbu ma bshes spring nas gzhung skal ni/ dge ba'i las lam bcu po lus dang ni/ /ngag dang yid kyi rtag tu brten bgyis shing / /chang rnams las bzlog de ni dge ba yi/ /'tsho ba la yang mngon par dges par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di byung bas rten 'brel shin du bzang ba yin no gsungs/ gzhan yang dus de'i tshe/'jam dbyangs don yod rnam rgyal bas chos sde chen po la dam pa'i chos dang / longs spyod rgya che ba'i sgo nas chos khrims bzang po legs par gtsugs/ khyad par don gnyer ba rnams la thugs shin du brtse ba'i dus 'di yin pas/ rje nyid kyi thugs sbyong la lhag par brtson par mdzad pa ni/ rnam 'grel gyi ṭig chen tshig don rab gsal phal cher slob dpon pa'i gsung ngag nas gnang zhing / lhag lus rnams nged rang gi bzung / blo la tshad mar chud/ spyi don lung rigs sgron me shin du blo la byang bar yod/ de skabs nas shel dkar du rigs chen pa'i zla la bsdad/ shes rab dang don gnyer shin du che ba'i grags pa thob/chos rje dang slob dpon pas thugs dges spro che bar mdzad/ brtse bas bskyangs pa yin gsungs/ de'i tshe brtson 'grus che ba ni khang gsar ba'i grwa tshang chos dbar 'degs gzhud mdzad dus 'grul gyi sgang yin kyang / gung tshigs mdzad pa'i dus lta bu la dge 'dun gzhan rnams gung tshigs kyi sta gon dang / skyem sang slong ba sogs mdzad/ rje nyid 'bog khres phogs 'phral phyag dpe bshig /gzhung bsnams nas slob dpon pa'i drung du byon te gzhung dogagasan/ de stobs kyi gzhung don 'chag ma nyung ba yin cing / chos sde po'i chos dbar phug gsar — 21 —

du bzhugs pa'i dus/ rje nyid gsan sbyong shin du nus pas mtshan mo shar sbyang mdzad pa'i gsung skad grwa pa gzhan sde srid mi cig pa rnams kyis kyang ngo shes shing / dpon btsun dngos grub dpal 'bar yin pa 'dug ces snyan pa'i sgra sgrogs par byed do/ /gzhan yang rje nyid bya bral grwa sa na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ slob dpon mkhan chen dpal blo bas rdzong dkar phyogs nas byung ba'i mi rnams la rje nyid la sku yon thugs bskyed ji ltar byung bris pa'i tshe/ thugs rab brtson 'grus thugs skyed shin du che ba'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ slob dpon pa'i zhal nas de yod pa bdog /khong pa la chos min pa gzhan byed rgyu mi ba dog ces bsngags pa mdzad zer ba'ang thos so/ /de nas slob dpon mkhan chen dpal blo ba de nyid byams chen rab 'byam pa'i thugs kyi sras mchog yin pa'i thad nas/ byams chen rab 'byam pa yab sras kyi rnam thar dang /bskyed tshal kyi snyan grags gsan pas yid rab tu phrogs te/ sku skye ba dpag tu med pa nas kyi 'dren mchog dam pa yin par dgongs/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus 'phags pa chos 'phags bsten pa ltar lus dang srog la ma chags par ci nas kyang zhabs drung du snyegs par thugs chas pa'i tshe/ rje nyid kyi rtsa ba'i dpon po sman khab nang sos/ grwa pa don gnyer ba nyi shu rtsa bgrang zhig lo gsum re'i chas gnangacaskyed tshal du rdzong thar snang ba'i grwa khral mdzad pa'i tshe/ gcig rje de nyid la 'byon dgos shar ba na/ yab kyis phag tu dpon po la zhu ba yang byas gtong ma nyan pa'i tshe/ grogs rnams thegs song bas thugs ma zug bar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mdo sdud pa la chos mo lan gsum bhe 22 —

mdzad pas/ gsum ka la/ dzha dper na seng ge ri sul brten nas 'jigs med par/ /ri dwags phra mo mang skrag byed cing sgra sgrogs ltar/ /mi yi seng ge shes rab pha rol phyin bsten nas/ /mu stegs pa rnams skrag byed 'jig rten sgra yang bsgrags/ /zhes pa babs byung bas/ shin du legs pa 'ong bar dgongs te/ tsham tshom med par bros byon pas/nyin lam gsum tsam phebs sar a co sleb byung / gang la 'ongs dris pas/ khyod 'bod du 'ongs pa yin zer bas/ thugs ma bde ba cig byung / log mi 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan byas pas/ bong bu gsum lho rdzas kyi khal gyis mnan bskur byung bas sems dga' bar byung / de dus pha ci zer dris pas/ da nga'i bu dang mi 'phrad 'di rnams skyol shog zer 'dug zer ba dang / nged kyang sems shin tu 'phreng ste/ re shig pha la 'phrad pa la log na drag pa yin nam snyam pa byung / de nas nged rnams kyi lam du zhugs yong bas chu 'dus su sleb pa na/ chu 'dus 'bum chen gyi gzhi 'dings pa dang 'dzom byung / de nas grogs ma rnyed par chu 'dus su zla ba tsam bsdad/ de nas chu 'dus pa'i grwa pa rgyal rtse la 'gro mkhan 'dra dang bsdebs/ lam lho rtsa brgyud nas byon/ kun mkhyen rin po che'i 'khrungs yul snar rdo pe zhes bya ba yin zhes par phebs pa dang / shin du nyams dga' zhing bla ma yid la dran pa zhig byung gsung /de nas skyed tshal du phebs shing mjal bka' zhus pa'i tshe/ dgongs ja cig gi steng du mjal bka' gnang / shar phyogs spos ngad ldan pa'i rir byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu dang / 'phags pa chos 'phags mjal ba ltar dga' spro dpag tu med pa thob/ de'i tshe kun mkhyen rin — 23 —

po che'i gsung nas/ khyed kyi dkyil na spyi don lung rigs sgron me blo la yod pa'i ba/tsun chung cig yod zer ba de su yin gsungs pa dang /'di lags zhes zhus pa ni/ khyod kyi lung rigs sgron me thon gyi yod dam gsungs pa dang / yod lags zhus tshe/ 'o na 'di na thon dang 'di nas thon dang gsungs byung ba'i tshe/ gang skyur sa nas legs par bton pag thugs shin tu dges shing / a la la btsun chung shes rab che/ 'di ltar slob cing bla ma la gus zhen che ba'i slob ma 'di lta bu yong ba bzang zhes mkhan chen dpal blo ba la'ang dges spro dpag tu med pa mdzad do/ /dus de nas bzung ste/ kun mkhyen yab sras gnyis la ci rigs par mtshan nyid theg pa'i gzhung lugs legs par sbyangs pa ni/thog mar tshad ma la sbyangs shing / rigs 'bring gi grwa la bzhugs pas blo tshogs nged rang che zhing bgros gleng khong rnams bde ba tsam 'dug /nged brtson 'grus che zhing thos pa la blo phyogs pas thams cad kyi don gnyer che ba'i dpe la bgrong pa dang / bla ma rnams kyi thugs rtsis shin du che bar mdzad/ rigs chen longs nas skabs cig tu dpe 'tshams la byon pa'i dus su/ snga dgongs thugs dam dang thugs gnyer gzhung ma'i sgrigs bcug yod pa rnams mdzad nas/ gung gseng la lung rigs rgya mtsho'i shog bu bcu re bzung bas/ yun ring ma 'gor bar khong du chud/ lung 'bring chos thog cig byas/ de nas lung chen gyi grwa la zhugs/ phar tshad gnyis la ston pa bzang ba'i thog chod/ thugs gnyer mdzad tshul ni/ chos sgang la nyin mo gsung chos zhu ba'i skabs ma gtogs bgros gleng 'ba' zhig dang / srod la rigs lung gi gzhug — 24 —

sdong rgyun rings mdzad/ de nas gzim chung du phebs thugs dam mdzad dgos rnams gnang / nam gyi gung la mnal thum pa re mdzad/jide 'phral bzhengs/ nam ma langs tsam gyi bar du thod skyong mdzad pa ni chag ma myong ba yin cing / slar yang gzim mal du phebs/ dam chos ni gu'i nyams len la sogs pacho 'od gsal gyi ngang la cung zad bzhugs/de nas phyag dpe zigs rtog sogs nyin bar gyi chos spyod kyi bya ba la 'jug par mdzad/ mdor na rje 'di nyid dang po thugs sbyong mdzad dus nas sku mya ngan las 'da' tshul ma bstan gyi bar du/ sgo gsum tha mal du bzhugs pa skad cig kyang ma mthong ba yin cing / phyag phyi ba rnams las kyang ma thos so/ /rje 'di nyid dadartsobartson shes rab snying rje lhag par gyur pa la/ thams cad smon zhing khyad par bla ma mchog tu mnyes phyir thugs brtse bas bskyangs pa na/ 'ga' zhig gis kun mkhyen rin po che la/ bla ma yang nye ring mdzad pa 'dug /dngos grub dpal 'bar la 'di 'dra'i bstod ra rang mdzad pa zhes smras pa brgyud nas kun mkhyen gyis gsan pas/ 'o na gser gyi bum pa gcig dang rdza'i bum pa gcig bshibs nas 'di gnyis gang dga' zer nas byung na/ gser gyi bum pa 'di dga' yo byas pa'i tshe/ 'di nyid nye ring byas pa yin nam/ kho bos ni nye ring byas pa med do zhes gsungs pa dang /bzhan yang kun mkhyen gyi zhal nas/ tshogs pa che yang char med sprin dang mtshungs/ /mtha ra phyin gcig gi thams cad gsal bar 'gyur/ /dgod dro zhes gzhan phan 'byung bar lung bstan to/ /bstan bcos kyi grangs ni/ sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa/ rig gter rtsa 'grel/ rnam — 25 —

'grel gyi 'grel chen brgyad/ byams pa dang 'grel ba'i chos sde nyi shu/mngon pa gong 'og /mdo rtsa la sogs pa 'dul ba'i skor/ dbu ma rigs tshogs/ bstod tshogs/ gtam tshogs/ bslab btus/ spyod 'jug /gzhan yang sgra dang / snyan ngag dang / sdebs sbyor dang /mngon brjod la sogs pa mtha' yas pa'i tshig don la legs par spyangs shing khong du chud par mdzad do/ /gnyis pa/ bshad bya bka' la ji ltar sbyangs pa'i tshul ni/ bka' dang po la rtsa ba'i lung so so thar pa'i mdo/ bshad pa'i mdo lung sde bzhi/ gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa/ las brgya pa/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa la sogs dang / bka' bar pa la sher phyin yum sras bcu bdun/ sher phyin nyi ma'i snying po/ zla ba'i snying po/ kun tu bzang po sogs sher phyin phyogs dang / bka' tha ma la sangs rgyas phal po che dang / myang 'das chen mo/'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sna tshogs pa/ mdo sil bu ba bcu bdun la sogs pa la legs par sbyangs shing khong du chud par mdzad do/ /da ni gnyis pa 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa la ji ltar sbyangs pa'i tshul ston te/ de'ang / rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel ba'i drung du/rdo rje theg pa'i chos skor gsan tshul ni/ pha rol du phyin pa'i theg pa dang thun mong du snang ba gsum gyi khrid/ mdo sngags 'tshams sbyor bar byed pa theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed/ dam tshig ma thob pa thob par byed pa kyai rdo rje yab kyi bka' dang / yum gyi dbang bka'/ dam tshig la gces spras su byed pa'i thabs rtsa ltung bcu bzhi pa'i bshad pa/— 26 —

dbang dus su thob pa'i lta ba gong 'phel du byed pa 'khor 'das dbyer med/ snang ba lhar 'char ba'i thabs bskyed rim kyi bshad pa/ de'i dmigs pa dang bcas pa/ lam dus kyi dbang rigi chu bo ma nub pa'i nyams len rgyun chags su byed pa'i thabs lam dus kyi dbang / lus dkyil bshad pa dang bcas pa/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa'i yan lag tu bdag med ma'i byin rlabs/ gsang dbang gi lam rlu nga dang gtum mo'i rnal 'byor/ dbang gsum pa'i lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo/ bzhi pa'i lam rdo rje rba rlabs kyi khrid yongs su rdzogs pa dang / de dag gi rgyab rten gzhung bshad gnya ga ma dang / de las 'phros pa'i yig chung rnams te/ mdor na lam 'bras kyi chos sna drug bcu rtsa bzhi sogs lam 'bras kyi chos skor rgya che ba lan gsum gyi bar du nos shing byang chub par mdzad do/ /dam chos ni gu'i chos la/ byin rlabs khog phubs kyi bka' gnyis/ gzhung shing gi bka' brgyad/ chos drug gi khrid tshig lung dang bcas pa/ chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang /ci tshig gsal/them yig /gzhi lam 'bras gsum/ khyad 'phags kyi gdams pa bco lnga/sgyu lus drug ldan/ khyad 'phags kyi gdams pa rgyas bsdus gsum/ bde mchog lha lnga'i mngon rtogs khyung pos mdzad pa dang / mkhas btsun pas mdzad pa gnyis/ sangs rgyas ston pas mdzad pa'i sngon 'gro'i chos/ phyag chen ga'u ma'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang / bka'/ khrid/ tshig lung dang bcas pa nos la/ 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang / mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rjes gnang / tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang rnams nos shing / blo sbyong don bdun ma 'grel pa dang bcas pa dang / skyid sdug lam 'khyer — 27 —

tshar brgyad gsan no/ /de'ang kun mkhyen rin po ches ni gu gsung ba zhig gi dus/ nged kyang shin du zhu ba spro nas/ thog mar nged rang gi zhu ba nan cher phul kyang / da lta slob gnyer gyi sgang yin pas mi yong gsung nas ma gnang / slar rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs la zhu ngo zhus/gser gyi thig po zho bco brgyad tsam yod pa zhig phul bas gsal kha cher ma byung na'ang / chos rnga byung tshe nged kyis kyang phyin te chos grwar bsdad pas/ de'i tshe nas zab chos rnams legs par gnang ba yin zhes gsung ngo / /'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge kun dga' chos bzang po'i drung du/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i chag med bzhi/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid yongs su rdzogs pa dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang bla ma rin 'byung la sogs pod dmar ma dkar chag ltar tshang ma/ dmar po skor gsum las tshogs dang bcas pa/ gshin rje bshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du smin byed kyi dbang spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/rnam rtog 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor/ rtsa ba rgyu'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa spros med kyi chos skor cha lag dang bcas pa/ ngan song yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa/ sbyong rgyud kyi brtag pa phyogs cig pa/ sbyong rgyud kyi sa bcad/ spyi don rje btsun grags pas mdzad pa/sbyong rgyud kyi ṭik+ka kun mkhyen go bos mdzad pa'i steng nas bshad pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ rdo rje 'chang gi bka' 'bum/ rje mus chen gyi bka' 'bum la sogs zab chos mtha' yas pa gsan no/ /de'ang rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs 'di nyid rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu bka' drin che zhing thugs shin tu brtse ba nas chos 'jig rten gyi bslab — 28 —

bya rnams 'phral la mdzad/ mdor na sku chas sogs la'ang ji ltar yod kyis 'dri rtog gnang / galol ja sogs cung zad dkon pa'i dus/ bla brang nas lhag par thugs rjes 'dzin/ bshad nyan gyi sgo nas bstan pa la phan 'dogs gtso cher dgos pa'i zhal dkod mdzad/ sku mya ngan las 'da' tshul ston pa'i dus su yang / sems can gyi don gyis/ khyad par kun mkhyen rin po che'i tshes gcig mchod pa ma chag pa gyis gsung pa'i bka' lung phebs shing dgongs pa'i dbyings na bzhugs pa yin no/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig pa'i grub chen/ spangs rtogs mthar thugs pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'dod dgu'i re ba bskong ba'i rin chen/ srid zhi'i skyon las skyob pa'i dpal mgon/ chos brgyad sgrog las grol ba'i bzang po ste mtshan brjod par dka' ba rdo rje 'chang chen po'i drung du/gtso bor sa skya bka' 'bum gyi lung / gsung ngag cha lag dang bcas pa/ tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang / rigs gsum spyi'i dbang / rnam 'joms kyi rjes gnang / gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi rjes gnang / mi g.yo ba sngon po'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/ don zhags kyi sgrub thabs/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na lha gcig gi rjes gnang / gsang 'dus 'jamartsopa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dbang dang rjes gnang / spyan ras gzigs gtso bor gyur pa lha bcu dgu'i dbang / de dag gi rgya gzhung / bod gzhung / spyan ras gzigs dang 'jam pa'i rdo rje mi 'dra ba'i khyad par dang bcas pa/ kye rdo rje bka' babs phyi ma gsum/ chag med bzhi bskyed rim nā ro mkha' spyod/ rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i khrid lam gyi yan lag dang bcas pa/ nang gi zab lam/ bla ma — 29 —

rin 'byung / brda chig brgyud/ sgrub pa lung sbyin rnams dang / rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gur/ thun mong gi bshad rgyud sam bhu ṭa rnams kyi bshad bka'/ bla ma gong ma'i rgyud kyi chos sna bcu gsum dang bcas pa/ gur lha brgyadang kyi rjes gnang /gur dpa' gcig gi rjes gnang / klu sgrub kyi mchod rten drung thob/pad ma badz+ra'i rdzogs rim mar me'i rtse mo/ grub chen tog tse pa'i bsam mi khyab byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ ngag dbang grags pa'i phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ nag po spyod pa'i gtum mo lam rdzogs/ nag po u tsi ṭa 'chi ba med pa'i yon po srong ba/ ḍom+bhi he ru ka'i lhan cig skyes grub/ in+t+ra bhu ti'i kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan nam/ phyag rgya lam rdzogs te lam skor phyi ma brgyad/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i lus dkyil gyi dbang / dril bu rim lnga'i khrid/ bde mchog dkar po'i khrid/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud dang / rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi bshad bka'/ bshad rgyud gzhan bzhi/ bla ma gong ma'i yig cha rnams kyi lung dang bcas pa/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang / zhen pa bzhi bral sogs zab chos mtha' yas pa gsan no/ /de'ang rje sangs rgyas rin chen 'di/ rje paṇa chen la thugs shin du brtse zhing thugs mthong shin du che bas/ de skabs dpal ldan sa skya pa'i chos skor phal cher bka' drin bskyangs/khyad par du 'bras yul rdzong dkar du spyan drangs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe/ zab chos ji ltar gnang ba thams cad rje 'di nyid kyi 'bad rtsol chen po'i sgo nas thugs su chud par mdzad/ phyis rje sangs rgyas rin chen gdan sa la phebs dus rjes ma'i tshe/ rje paṇa chen la — 30 —

stod bsam gling na bzhugs pas gsan te/ mjal ba la phebs pa dgongs pa la shar dus/ phyag phyi ba rnams kyis rje sangs rgyas rin chen pa yang phrin las rgya che ba'i thad nas sa skya ru rgyun ring bzhegs pa dka'/ 'di na yang sku khams bde grags rang mi 'dug pas/ da lan 'then pa zab lags chozhus tshe/ re zhig dgongs pa la bzhugs/ da lan ci nas kyang mjal ba byed/ da lan ma mjal na phyis mjal ba dka' ba 'dug gsung thugs thag cad nas byon/ de bar rje sangs rgyas rin chen pas kyang dgon par bzhugs/ de nas dpon slob mjal 'phrad legs par gnang / dges spro dang bcas pa'i ngang nas tshogs pa spyi la yang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad/ de nas lo shas kyi bar la rje dpon slob gnyis ka mya ngan las ma 'das par bzhugs pa yin yang mjal thengs rjes mar byung bas/ mngon mkhyen gyi dgongs par gor ma chag go /mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug rin chen rnam rgyal ba'i zhal mnga' nas lam 'bras kyi khrid/ gzhung bshad a seng ma/ sras don ma/dmar ma/ dmar po skor gsum gyi rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma'i dbang / tshe khrid zhal shes dang bcas pa/ kun mkhyen rong po nas ba/ rgyud pa'i tshe khrid/ rnam 'joms ba ri ba'i lugs kyi ri—gas gtad/ rnam 'joms bir lugs/ skyer khang lugs thugs rje chen po'i rigs gtad/ u tsa'i rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ sgrol ma lha bcu gsum ma/ sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang chos skor dang bcas pa/ rta mgrin nag po'i rdzes gnang / rta mgrin gsang sgrub las tshogs dang bcas pa/ sgrol ma lha bcu gsum ma/— 31 —

bcu bdun ma/ gur rigs bsdus kyi dbang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje lha so gnyis/ brgyud pa'i bka' babs bdun ldan gyi dbang bka'/ sgrub thabs gtsor byas/ de'i rgya cher bshad pa/ bskyed rims gsal byed/ sgrub thabs mdo sras/ klu byang gis mdzad pa'i rnam bzhag rim pa/ ār+ya de bas ro bsreg gi cho ga /klu sgrub kyi dkyil chog nyi shu pa/ klu lo'i dkyil chog /nag po pa'i dkyil chog dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog /zla grags kyi rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs/bsang 'dus rtsa rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma/ 'grel chen sgron gsal/ 'grel bshad mtha' drug gsal ba/ bshad thabs kyi yan lag gsang ba'i sgo 'byed/ bshad rgyud dgongs pa lung ston le'u bcu gnyis pa/ rdo rje phreng ba le'u drug bcu rtsa brgyad pa/ lha mo bzhis zhus pa/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus te/ bshad rgyud rnam bzhi/ byang chub sems 'grel/ klu grub kyi rim lnga'i gzhung / 'phags pa lha'i spyod bsdus sgron me la sogs pa nos shing gong du bstan pa ltar/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen la ye shes zhabs lugs nos pa rnams dang bcas/ mdor na 'dus pa skor gsum gyi rgyud man ngag dgongs 'grel gyi gzhung / bod kyi skyes bu chen po so so'i bstan bcos mtha' yas pa dang bcas pa gsan/ bde mchog lo hi pa'i dbang bka' lo hi pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dpal mngon par rtogs pa de'i 'grel pa/ phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga /lhag mchod/ gtor chog ste de bzhi pradzha rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa/ bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang bka'/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs/dkyil chog sbyin bsres gi cho ga ste bskyed rim bskor gsum/ dbyings — 32 —

kyi thig le gsang ba'i de kho na nyid rab tu gsal ba/ o la pa ti dang rdzogs rim skor gsum ste/ nag po bzhung drug /bde mchog dril bu lugs dang / kha che lugs te brgyud pa'i bka' babs gnyis dang ldan pa'i dbang bka'/ dril bu skor gsum/ mkha' spyod byin rlabs/bskyed rim phag mo mkha' spyod/ rdzogs rims rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi yan lag skra sen dbab ba/ gnod sbyin mo dbang du bya ba/ sman chen po'i bcud len/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ sbyin bsreg gi cho ga sogs cha lag dang bcas pa/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang / ro lang brgyad skor gyi dbang / las gshin gyi rjes gnang / mngon par rtogs pa rim pa lnga/ smin byed dbang gi chu bo/ rnal 'byor bzhi khrid/ rwa rtse sems 'dzin gyi khrid/ rgyud rtog pa bdun pa/ bshad rgyud rtog gsum/dkar 'grel/ nag 'grel/ man ngag bcud thigs/ rtog bdun gyi ṭik+ka/ rtag gsum gyi gsal byed/ zhal shes/ bsnyen sgrub las gshin sgron ma/ dmar po mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ shog ril gsum/ de'i gsal byed/ drug bcu pa'i gtor chog /dug dbang rma bya rgyas pa/ sbyin bsreg gi cho ga /uk+ṇi ṣa'i gdams ngag sogs mdor na rā pod dkar chag ltar tshang ma gsan/ dam chos ni gu'i skor la/ rtsa ba ni gu chos drug /sdong po phyag rgya chen po/ yal ga lam 'khyer rnam gsum/ me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar/ 'bras bu lus sems 'chi med kyi bka'/khrid/ lung / man ngag /mgon po'i chos skor dang bcas pa lan gsum gyi bar du nos/ sbyong rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang /'phags pa'i bka' 'bum/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes/ sgrub thabs brgya — 33 —

rtsar grags pa/ sgrub thabs dgu bcu rtsa drug gi rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa/ mgon po lha brgyad/ lha bcu gnyis ma'i rjes gnang / mgon po'i chos skor cha lag dang bcas pa/ mgon po zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang chos skor cha lag dang bcas pa ste zab chos mtha' yas pa gsan no/ /khyad par tshogs bdag gi rjes gnang gsan pa'i skabs su rje nyid kyi sku pang du ja sigs kyi gzugs cig babs pas/ rje rin chen rnam rgyal gyi zhal nas/ 'o shin du rten 'brel bzang / rab 'byam pa dngos grub dpal 'bar ba la ja mod po yong/ sngon rdo rje 'chang gis rje mus chen la rjes gnang mdzad pa'i dus/ rta'i gzugs gcig sku 'phang du babs pas/ zla ba gcig gi khongs su rta bco brgyad byung ba yin gsung lung bstan mdzad pa ltar rje paṇa chen 'di nyid la gsol ja shin du 'bol bar byung ba ni/ rje yab sras gnyis ka'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i yon tan yin par nges pa'o/ /khams gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po/rigs gsum rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul/ gangs can chol kha gsum gyi bdag po/ dpal sa skya lo tsā ba kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal mnga' nas/ kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi dbang / rdo rje phur pa'i dbang / drag po sgrol dbang rnams nos/ rgya chen chos kyi spyan ldan sku zhang chos rje kun dga' snying po'i zhal mnga' naso/ zha lu pa'i lugs kyi dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dpal rgyu skar gyi 'khor lo lha stong phrag brgya nyi shu'i smin byed kyi dbang / rdzogs rims sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i khrid/ khrid yig gi lung dang bcas pa/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud/ 'grel chen dri med 'od/ bu ston pas mdzad pa'i — 34 —

mngon rtogs/ dkyil chog /rab gnas sbyin bsreg sogs dang / phyag na rdo rje'i rjes gnang / mngon rtogs yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ rnam sras kyi rjes gnang / mngon rtogs dgos 'dod 'byung ba/ bstod pa rgyal po thugs rab tu mnyes par byed pa rnams gsan/ sku zhang 'phag/sa mchog chos rje la/ rje btsun bo dong pa'i chos skor rnams gsan /'brom ston rgyal ba'i sras mchog mtshungs med ngag gi dbang po grags pa dpal bzang po'i zhal mnga' nas la sgrol dkar yid bzhin nor bu bka' yidams lugs kyi rjes gnang / 'jam dpal nag po'i rig pa gtad pa/ phag mo shes rab gsal byed kyi dbang / phag dkar gyi rjes gnang / lha mo dbyangs can ma'i rjes gnang / mkha' 'gro seng ge gdong can gyi rjes gnang / lha de dag gi yig cha rgya gzhung bod gzhung rnams dang / bka' gdams glegs bam/ rgyal sras bka' 'bum gyi lung rnams nos/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel bstan bcos la blo gros thogs med du rgyas pa mkhyen brtse mtshungs pa med pa'i mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang po'i zhal mnga' nas/ bla ma gser gling pa'i blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa dang / rtog pa 'bur 'joms/ bla ma dharma rak+ṣi ta'i mtshon cha 'khor lo dang / rma bya dug 'joms/ bla ma/ byams pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ dge sgom rdo rje'i glu/ ga'/na yang blo sbyong kun du bzang po/ thun gcig ma/ lhan thabs bzhi ma/ rnam dag btsug gi nor bu/ gsang sngags lugs kyi blo sbyong / blo sbyong don bdun ma/skyid sdug lam 'khyer/ bka' gdams thor bu ba/ lce sgom pa'i byang chub sems sbyong / glang thang pa'i tshig rkang brgyad ma/ 'chims kyi blo — 35 —

sbyong thun gcig ma/ blo sbyong gdung thag skor gsum/ mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i chos bzhi rnams gsan no/ /byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i 'byung gnas/ rnam rtog gi spros pa'i madzhan ma nye bar zhi ba'i yid bzhin gyi rgya mtsho chen po la dbang 'byor bas skal ldan gyi gdul bya rnams kyi re ba yongs su bskong ba'i mkhas grub gdengs can gyi dbang po chos rje kun dga' blo gros pa'i zhal mnga' nas/ jo nang lugs kyi dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang lung khrid man ngag dang bcas rnams dang / thig le bcu drug gi bka'/ 'brom chos kyi rgyal po nyid kyis rang rgyud la bskul ma 'debs pa dad pa'i ljon shing / pha chos nor bu'i phreng ba'i rtsa ba le'u nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba la le'u nyer gsum dang / bka' rgya/ ma 'ongs lung bstan rdo rje glu gsum la le'u re re te nyi shu rtsa drug /bu chos skor la/ rngog chos nyi shu/khu chos gnyis/ gzhan yang ma 'ongs lung bstan chen mo/ 'chi med rdo rje'i glu/ ngo mtshar ba'i gtam thor bu ba ste/ bka' gdams glegs bam yongs su rdzogs pa gsan no/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po chos sku ho ru ka chen po'i zhal mnga' nas/ snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang / sa bcad ma rig mun selnga/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i gzhung chung / lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor dgu/ phyag chen yi ge bzhi pa/ phyag chen bsam mi khyab brgyad/ phyag chen gang ga ma/ chos nyid gnyug ma'i mgur/ te lo'i btad rgya/ snyan brgyud nor bu skor gsum gyi khrid rgyas pa/ smin lam gyi sdom tshig /smin lam yid bzhin nor bu la/ bde mchog drug bcu rtsa gnyis kyi dbang rgyas pa nas/ brda'i don dbang gi ge 36 —

bar la dbang phra rigs bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad du phye ba/ thun mong yid bzhin nor bu la yab kyi mngon rtogs bzhi/ yum gyi mngon rtogs bzhi ste brgyad/ las byang yid bzhin nor bu/ yab skor yum skor gyi bstod pa/ bskyed rim gsal nyi/lke rab gnas rgyal ba kun bsdus/ sbyin bsres phrin las lhun grub/ 'khrul 'khor gsal ba'i me long / nā ro gsang spyod/ zhal shes sna tshogs pa'i skor/ ye shes mgon po'i chos skor/ tshe ring ma'i chos skor la sogs te snyan brgyud cha lag dang bcas pa/gzhan yang o rgyan bsnyen sgrub/ ri chos skor ga kha la sogs pa zab chos mtha' yas pa nos/ de'ang rje gtsang pas rje nyid la brtse ba chen pos zhal gdams gnang ba ni/ bka' brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos kun chos nyid ji lta'i ngo bo rtogs/ /spub mtha' chos can rnam pa ji snyed mkhas/ /dpal ldan khyod ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yi/ /dpal du 'bar zhing rtag tu rgyal myur cig /ces pa'i don dang mthun nges pa'i skyes bu de la bsngag4pa/ yi ge rten bcas byung bas sems spro/ sngar thos pa'i sgo nas lung gi bltan pa nyin mor byas pa legs/ da sgrub pa'i sgo nas rtogs pa'i bstan pa mi la ras pa'i rnam thar 'di la bltas nas 'jin 'tshal/ de phyir rnam thar don bsdus tshigs bcad chos nyid ngang nas yi ger bkod pa e waṃ ma ya zhes bka' bstsal to/ /gzhan yang skabs 'gar chos dung dkar po phyag dam 'byar ba gnang sbyin mdzad/ gzhan phan 'byung ba'i rten 'brel yin gsung ba dang / skyed tshal du pheb du.oṃ zab so'i man ngag cig gnang ba'i rjes su/ rje gtsang pa'i zhal mnga' na 'di lta bu'i man ngag — 37 —

'di nyams su blangs ba la 'bras bu khyad par can 'di 'dra 'byung ba'i mtshon byed/ bzung 'dzin yul phud cing / dbu ma'i bzhugs tshul 'bur du dod pa'i ltad mo cig smra ba'i seng ge la ston ang gsung ba sogs thugs yid cig tu 'dres pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i gsung tshul bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /grub mchog he ru ka chen po dbus smyon kun dga' bzang po'i zhal mnga' nas la rgyal po do ha sha lo ka bzhi bcu pa/btsun mo do ha sha lo ka brgyad bcu pa/ dmangs do ha sha lo ka brgya drug bcu pa ste/ do ha skor gsum/ ngan rdzong snyan brgyud kyi 'khrul 'khor/'ba' ra ba'i yig chung 'ga'/ chos drug dril ba rdo rje'i glu rnams nos/grub chen byang chub rdzong pa'i drung du/ kun rig /dam tshig gsum bkod/ rnam snang mngon byang gi dbang rnams nos so/ /'jam dbyangs don yod rnam rgyal ba'i dung du/ rdor dbyings/ 'jigs byed/ gshed dmar/ gsang 'dus/ bde mchog lū dril/ mkha'aji'agro rgya mtsho/ dus 'khor/ kye sdor sogs kyi dbang nos so/ /grub chen skya phyi rin po che'i zhal mnga' nas/ gcod kyi skor mtha' yas pa nos la/ gzhan yang grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgyal dbang chos grags rgya mtsho/ rje btsun kun dga' lhun grub/ kun mkhyen byang chub blo gros/ rje mgon po dbang phyug rnams la chos mtha' yas pa nos shing / mdor na bod gangs ri'i khrod na deng sang grags pa'i zab chos phal mo che rje 'di'i legs par gsan mod/ 'dir rags rim de tsam las ma smos la/ blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis gsan yig zab don rgya mtshor bltas pas shes so/ /de ltar zab rgyas chu klung kun 'dus legs bshad rlabs phreng — 38 —

g.yo ba can/ /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i dpal 'khrungs mkhyen bzang rin chen dri med rab 'bar ba/ /skye dgu'i gdung sel thugs rje'i klung phran stong 'bab/sa phan bde'i zer 'phro zhing / /bskal brgyar g.yo bas rmongs pa'i dri ma dag byed ye shes rgyun can rgyal/ /lnga pa mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pas rgya chen mkhas pa'i dbang po' go 'phang brnyes pa'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi ma da pa ni/ rgya chen mkhas mang 'dus pa'i tshogs dbus su/ /zhes pa la sogs pa 'di la/legs sbyangs mthar phyin pa mkhas pa'i grags pa spel ba'i ched du/bstan pa'i rnam bzhag mdzad tshul dang / de ltar mdzad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan lung dang sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rje paṇa chen 'di nyid gong du bshad pa ltar/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos rgya mtsho lta bu la legs spyad sngon du song bas chos la rang byan chud pa/ mkhas pa rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mthar son zhing / rgyan drugaspachog gnyis la sogs pa shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po'i gzhung lugs rnams kyi tshig don mtha' dag la thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen pa rgyas pas/ gangs can mkhas pa'i mkhas pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan du gyur pa yin zhing / khyad par dgung lo sum bcu bzhes pa shing mo sbrul gyi lo gzhung lugs rab 'byams gyi grwa skor mdzad par dgongs pa'i tshe/ kun mkhyen yab sras kyis/ gong ma chen mo/ chos sde'i las 'dzin sogs la/ zhu yig phyag dam ji ltar 'os pa dang bcas/ chu 'dus pa kun dga' bya ba'i phyag phyi ba gcig khrid dpon slob gnyis pos dpal rtse thang gi chos grwa chen por phyag phebs nas/ thog mar chos rje kun spangs pa gong ma chen mo'i gsol dpon — 39 me

mdzad pa'i dus yin pas khong pa la mjal kha zhus/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i phyag dam cig yod pa phul/ nged tsho skyed tshal nas grwa skor bltan pa'i rnam bzhag la 'ongs pa yin lags/ rgyas pa 'bum gyi thog drangs pod chen brgya dang gsum la rnam bzhag byed rgyu yin lags pas/gong ma chen mo dang / chos sde'i che bgres rnams la de ltar rgyu mtshan 'bul lugs dang / 'phral dgos kyi bslab bya rnams kyang gnang dgos lags zhus pas/ brdzun ma byed/ sngar de 'dra'i po ti mang ba la grwa skor byed mkhan su yang byung ba med/ khong rab 'byams pa'am gang nas 'byon zhing yod gsung ba dang / de bdag rang lags/ po ti'i grangs yang nges pa can yin pas gong du snyan zhus phul bas khyab zhus pa dang / khong pas kyang phebs te gong ma chen mo la zhu yig rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa phul ba'i tshe/ gong ma'i zhal nas/ de 'dra gang yin mi shes/ grwa pa rang kha ba'i gre mo byas pa yin pa'ang srid/ ltos shog dang gsung / chos rjes gzigs pas sngar gyi shul na bzhugs 'dug /slar log ste sngar shul na bzhugs 'dug lags zhus pas/ gnas tshang du bos/ 'phral chas sogs legs par bskyol/ de nas brtags shing dpyad nas byed gsung ba'i bka' lung phebs pa ltar chos rjes nged la yang bka' lung sgyur song / nged kyi kyang gnas tshang du phyine sdad pa na yon mchod rnams bka' bgros la/ da lan gyi grwa skor ba 'di po ti shin tu grangs mang bas nged rang gi chos sde chen po'i brjid ma shor ba cig dgos pas/ ga/zhung las pa rnams kyis gzigs rtog legs po mdzod/ gzhung ma thon pa'am/ gzhung 'khrul pa sogs ma byung pa gyis — 40 —

gsungartsoba'i gong ma'i bka' lung nan chen phebs 'dug /nged la yang po ti grangs mang ba legs po yin na'ang / thams cad la bshar gnan thub na byed/ de min mi yong gsung ba phebs byung bas/ bshar gnan shin du nas rkyang thub lags pas thugs rjes bzung / bdag khamase bshis ngan pas bsdad nas bshar gnan byas chog pa dgos lags zhus tshe/ de shin tu nas yong gsung / bshar gnan zla gcig lhag tsam byas pa la/ sher phyin gyi mdo ji snyed yod pa/ mdo sil bu ba bcu bdun/ dkon rtsegs kyi sdom gsum bstan pa'i mdo la sogs pa bka'i po ti thams cad song rjes/ bstan bcos yang kha yar song ba dang / da ma gnan na yang bzod pa 'dug zer nas/ gzhan rnams la gzhung skal len pa tsam byas/ de'i tshe yon mchod thams cad shin du dges shing / sku yon rgya che chung la rtsod pa mi 'dug /tshad ma la bgro gleng mdzad dgos gsung nas mdzad pas/ ston pa bzang ba'i thog chod de/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir grwa skor gyi rnam bzhag mdzad pa la 'di las sku yon che ba sngon chad ma byung zhing / da dung yang mi 'byung zhes snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs de nyid du khyab par gyur to/ /de yi stobs kyi sku drag zhan thams cad kyi thad nas gsol ja'i zhal dkar zhu ba dbus mi thob pa tsam byung / de dus ja bzang ba dang / snga dgongs slob gnyer byas drag pas/ nged kyi khams bshis dang so la yang skyon par byung gsung / khyad par gong ma chen pos rtsed thang du bzhugs rin zhabs tog phul du phyin pa bsgrubs/ yar phyogaso la 'byon dus srab chen gyi chos gos shin du legs pa gcigasmogi tho/ga drangs/ gnang sbyin — 41 —

bzang pa dang / gsol ras la sogs pa'i gnang sbyin mi khung bcu gnyis mdzad/ rje nyid kyi sku yon la bsngags pa che cher mdzad do/ /grwa skor mdzad pa'i po ti'i grangs ni/ rgyas pa 'bum po ti gcig tu byas/nyi khri po ti gcig tu byas te/ sher phyin yum sras bcu bdun de'i steng du sher phyin nyi ma'i snying po/ zla ba'i snying po/ kun du bzang po dang gsum bsnan pas sher phyin gyi mdo nyi shu/ bka' gdams pa la gtso bor grags pa'i mdo sil bu ba bcu bdun gyi steng du dkon mchog brtsegs pa nas sdom gsum bstan pa'i mdo/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo/ byams pa lung bstan pa'i mdo/ de gsum bsnan pas nyi shu/ bstan bcos la byams pa dang 'brel ba'i chos sde nyi shu/ tshad ma sde bdun/ mdo/ rig gter rtsa 'grel/ sdom gsum/ so thar gyi mdo/'dul ba tshig le'ur byas pa/ sum brgya pa/ ka ri ka /sgra'i bstan bcos kā la pa/ mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo/ snyan mngags me long /sdebs sbyor gyi bstan bcos mu tig gi chun po/ mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos tshig gter te nyi shu/ mngon pa mdzod/ dbu ma'i skor la/ rig tshogs lnga/ bden gnyis/ chos dbyings bstod pa/ sems kyi rdo rje la bstod pa/ rten 'brel la bstod pa/ thabs thugs rje chen po la bstod pa/ sher phyin la bstod pa/ sku gsum la bstod pa/ mchod rten brgyad la bstod pa/ dbu ma shes spring / dbu ma rin chen phreng ba/ dbu ma bzhi brgya pa/ 'jus pa/ spyod 'jug /mdo kun las btus te nyi shu/de rnams kyi steng du gur rtag saṃ gsum bsnan pas brgya dang gsum yin no/ /po ti brgya sum bcu zhes grags kyang / 'bum la bcu drug /nyi khri — 42 —

la bzhi sogs byasmo pa yin gsung / poñtsati'i grangs kha mi mthun pa mang du grags kyang / phyis tho yig rnyed pa ltar bris pa yin pas 'di kho na la yid ches par byos shig /de'i tshe rtsed thang pa rnams kyi mtshan gsang rab 'gro shes su gsol zhing grags so/ /skabs der/ grwa skor phun sum tshogs par grub nas/ skyed tshal la log 'byon grabs yod tshe/ rje gtsang pa rtsed thang du phebs pa gsan pas/ sku tshe snga ma nas kyi 'dren pa yin par dgongs/ mjal ba la thugs shin du spro te/ mjal ba la phebs phyag 'bul mdzad tshe/ rje gtsang pa'i zhal nas/ 'o da lo chos sde chen po na grwa skor ba sngags chos ba ni shin du mang bar yod 'dug /mtshan nyid pa gcig 'dug zer ba khyod yin nam gsung ba dang /gzhan yang khyed dang snga gong na 'phrad dgos bsam pa yod na'ang rten 'brel mtsho'agrig /da lan 'phrad pas sems shin du dga' gsung ba sogs dges spro 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar mdzad do/ /nged rtsed thang na yod dus/ kun mkhyen rin po che dag pa mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan/ me tog gi char pa kun du stobs che bar babs nged rigs lung la yod pa'i dus me tog gi char stobs che bar 'bab kyi 'dug pa la/ la la na re/ a la la 'di 'dra gang yin na zer/ 'ga' zhig na re/ byams chen rab 'byam pa mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan pa'i ltas yin pa 'dug ngo mtshar che zer/ kha cig na re/ de bas kyang khong gi phrin las kyi gangs can gyi ljongs thams cad khyab pa 'di ngo mtshar che mod ces kun mkhyen rin po che'i snyan pa kho na brjod cing 'dug /nged sems ma bde ba zhig byung / gnas tshang du phyin/ rtse cig — 43 —

tu gsol ba btab tho rangs gnyid du song ba'i mi lam na/ kun mkhyen rin po che 'di/ mkhan chen g.yag pa'i sku'i skye ba yin zer ba cig byung gsung / de nas grwa tshang du phebs pa'i tshe/ mtshan gzhung lugs brgya pa dngos grub dpal 'bar du gsol zhing grags so/ /de nas kun mkhyen rin po che'i mchod 'bul gyi bya ba rnams legs par grub rjes/phyag dpe gzigs tog dgos pa rnams mdzad/ slar yang rab 'byam pa rdo rje ba zhes rje rang dang 'khrungs yul yang cig pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa chen po de dang sdeb/ chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po don grub 'phags pa'i grwa sa dpal 'khor bde chen gyi chos grwa chen por phebs/po ti grangs 7nga ba la grwa skor mdzad pa'i dgongs pa yod na'ang /chos sde chen po'i sgrig rnam bzhag la brten/ rgyas pa 'bum gyi thog drangs pod chen bcu drug/ tsam la grwa skor mdzad pas/ mkhas pa chen po'i grags pa brnyes/ dus phyis kyi grwa skor ba bzang ba'i dper 'os so zhes sku mched gnyis ka la bsngags par byed do/ /de'i tshe mtshan paṇa chen rgyal yum gsum pa zhes gsol zhing / chos rgyal mi rabs chen pos 'phral chas sogs gnang sbyin bzang po dang bcas thugs brtse bas bskyangs pa yin gsung / de nas grwa tshang du phebs bshad nyan la sogs pa bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad pa yin no/ /de'ang legs par sbyangs pa'i skabs su mdo rgyud bstan bcos mtha' dag la sbyangs shing bstan pa'i rnam bzhag 'gran zla dang bral bar mdzad pa la brten nas mkhas pa'i dbang po'i go 'phang brnyes phyir gangs can bstan pa'i bdag por gyur te/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis la sogs pa'i gzhung ge 44 —

lugs rmyel bzhi na du smra ba deng sang gangs ri'i khrod na rje paṇa chen 'di nyid las gzhan su yang yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ni rje nyid kyi zhal mnga' nas/ phyis dus rtog ge'i rings lugs nyams pas/ /byis rnams mgubād sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor/ /tha snyad tshig gi bslu khrid mkhan gyi/ /kun btags 'khrul pa'i sprin dpung tshogs kyis/ /dasongs don nyin byed dbang po sgribs te/ /gzhung lugs pad tshal zums 'di mthong nas/ /kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i chu gtsang las 'khrungs/ /'jam dbyangs pad dkar rgyas pa'i zhal nas/ /zab don bdud rtsi'i ro bcud myangs pas/ /rtsom 'chad rtsod pa'i lus stobs rgyas te/ /dngos stobs rigs pa'i gzhung brgya dag la/ /'jigs med smra ba'i spobs pa rab grub/ /dpal ldan kun dga'i dgongs pa 'chad la/ /zab rgyas blo gros rab tu 'bar ba'i/ /rnam dpyod 'od stong rgyas pa'i mkha' nas/ /lung rigs tsha zer 'bum phrag 'asgoba'i/ /rnam par bshad byed dbang po 'char gyi/ /don ga nyer rkang drug ldan pa'i tshogs rnams/ /legs ba shad ge sar bye ba las byung / nges don sbrang rtsi'i bcud la rol dang //zhes dang / khyad par sher phyin gyi mdo'i tshig don smra ba la rje 'di nyid las lhag pa da lta gangs can gyi khrod na yod pa ma yin no zhes gsungs pa ni/ rje paṇa chen nyid kyi zhal mnga' nas/ rgyal yum sher phyin yid 'o nga pad tshal la/ /kho bo'i rnam dpyod 'od stong shar ba yis/ /yid 'ong tshigs bcad pad mo legs rgyas pas/ /rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha rnams nas bzung ste/ /'og min bar gyi dkar phyogs lha rnams ni/ /ngo mtshar cher gyur mkha' la lding bzhin du/ /me tog 'thor te sgra dbyangs — 45 ——

'di skad sgrog /rgyal bar gyur cig bstan 'dzin skyes bu khyod/ /sku tshe ring zhing phrin las rgyas gyur te/4 /sangs rgyas bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas byed shog /sngon chad gangs ri'i khrod 'dir byon pa yi/ /rab mang mkhas pa rgyu skar tshogs rnams kyi/ /sher phyin pad tshal rgyas par ma nus na/ /khyod ni bstan pa'i 'od stong su yin zhes/ /sgrogs pa'i sgra ni gang gi mi thos de/ /rna ba'i dbang po med pa yin nam ci/ /zhes dang /kho bos chags sdang med par rgyal yum sher phyin 'bum/ /tshigs bcad yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng bar legs byas nas/ /rgya gar paṇa chen mkhas pa'i 'grel pa'i lugs bzhin du/ /sbas don sems bskyed rims pa mdo dang legs sbyar bas/ /g.yu 'brug ngo mtshar che des phyogs bcu kun rgyugs nas/ /dngos grub dpal 'bar rnam dpyod 'od stong 'od zer gyis/ /rgyal yum dgongs don ge sar snying po gsal lo zhes/ /sa steng ma lus khyab par 'ur 'ur cis mi sgrog /ces gsungs so/ /gnyis pa de ltar mdzad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan lung dang sbyar ba ni/gong du bshad pa de ltar gsung rab rgya che ba la sbyangs pa dang / bstan pa'i rnam bzhag 'gran zla dang bral bar mdzad nas/ gzhan las mchog tu gyur pa'i mkhas pa chen po yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa 'di/mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyi mi shes bzhin du shes so dgongs nas zhal gyis bzhes pa'ang ma yin/ shes pa dang mi shes pa gang gi yang rtog dpyod ma btang par snyon chig ltar 'dod rgyal du zhal gyi bzhes pa'ang ma yin/snyan grags kho na 'dod pa'i phyir zhal gyis bzhes pa'ang ma yin gyis/skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi tshul bzung nas shes pa la legs par shes so — 46 —

zhes zhal gyis bzheyopa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rje pan chen 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rnams su bltas pas shes so/ /'o na thugs rgyud la yon tan bzhugs pas chog mod/ phyis byung gi mkhas pa gzhan gyis ma dgongs pa rje 'di nyid kyis lhag par dgongs so gsung pa mi rigs so snyam na/ de ni rjes 'jug gi gdul bya rnams tshul 'di lta bu la spro bas 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yang 'di lta bus 'dzin nus so zhes shes pa'i phyir du gsung—sa pa yin te/ ji skad du slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzin byed pa smra byed dang / /sgrub par byed pa kho na'o/ /zhes so/ /tshul 'di lta bu ni/ nga rgyal la sogs pa med du zin kyang / slob dpon snga ma rnams kyis kyang gsungs pa yin te/ dpal ldan chos kyi grags pas/ gal te chos kyis grags pa yi/ /smra ba'i nyi ma nub pa na/ /chos rnams gnyid log yang na shi/ /chos ma yin rnams da gdod longs/ /zhes dang / slob dpon shes rab 'byung gnas kyis/ shes rab 'byung gnas skyes pa'i tshe/ /shes bya'i tshogs rnams mi 'dar na/ /de la sems med yang na ni/ /smugs sam ba glang mngon sum yin/ /zhes dang / slob dpon blo brtan gyis/bdag blo phyogs cig gzhal ba dang / /gzhan blo phyogs cig gzhal ba gnyis/ /gal te tshad la gzhal rung na/ /srang la gzhal na bdag blo rtsi/ /zhes dang / dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ /shes bya'i mkha' la thogs pa med rgyu zhing / /phas rgol nyi zla'i gzi brjid za nus kyang / /rtag tu skye bo kun gyi mi mthong bas/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan nam mkha'i sgra gcan — 47 —

'dra/ /zhes sogs bsngags pa mdzad pa mtha' yas so/ /grags snyan rlung chen brgya phrag gis/ /zhags pas phyogs bcur rab drangs kyang / /mkhyen rab gtingad+kuzab mi 'gul pa/ /'di ni dpag yas rgya mtsho'am ci//da ni drug pa zab lam la gnad du bsnun pas grub pa brnyes pa'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi mdzad pa ni/ rgyal ba rgya tsho'i tshogs kyis rjes su bzung / /zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /'di la rgya chen gzhung lugs de dgo gi don thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i tshul/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis rjes su bzung ba'i tshul/ bstan bsrung dam can rgya mtshos phrin las bsgrubs pa'i tshul/ lkog gyur gyi gnas la lung bstan mdzad pa'i tshul/ dag pa'i gdul bya la grub pa'i mdzad pa bstan tshul bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rje paṇa chen 'di'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams bzang po snang la rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i lta ba dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas spros bcas spros med kyi mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / bdag cag rnams la mngon sum du gyur pa ni/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig la nam gyi gung thun rnams grol nas slar yang tho rangs kyi cha la dpal ldan sa skya pa'i chag med bzhi zhes yongs su grags pa 'di dag dang / bla ma rin 'byung / bir srung thun mong ma yin pa rnams thun bzhi ma/ bde mchog /gshed dmar/ 'jigs byed/ tshe sgrub kyi skor la/grub rgyal ma'i tshe sgrub/ kun mkhyen rong po nas brgyud pa'i tshe sgrub/ sgra mi snyan gyi tshe sgrub/ snyan brgyud nas bshad pa'i tshe sgrub/ mgon po khro bcu'i srung 'khor sogs chag med rab tu mang po dag thun gsum ma'am/ gnyis las mi nyung bar mdzad/ yi dam chos skyong de dag gi — 48 —

snying po nye snying la sogs ji ltar 'os pa dang / gcod kyi dmigs pa rnams kyang mdzad/ mthar nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyi gzims te/ mnal dus su rmi lam sbyong spel/ sprul bsgyur sogs kyi nyams len zab mo la rtsal 'don par mdzad/ de nas zhu ba glus bskul ba sogs bzhengs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis bzhengs nas slar yang snga thun gyi rim pa de dag la 'jug par mdzad do/ /thun 'tshams kyi bya ba la/ tho rangs dkar cha bzhi/ gzhi bdag gtor ma dang bcas pa/ gung tshigs grol 'phral yon chab khrus gsol/ chu sbyin 'dzam ser nag /gzhi bdag /brgya rtsa/ bar do/ lhag ma/ mi g.yo ba/ dbyug gu/ sgrol ma/ grul gtor/ cha gsum gtor ma la sogs pa rnams dang / skabs su chos gtor/ thun gtor sogs dang / phyag tshwa gdab pa'i cho ga phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas pas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku nyer gcig re/ chos sku'i mchod rten chen mo brgyad re/ rnam rgyal gyi gzungs ring nyer gcig re/ rtsa rgyud rtag pa gnyis pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa sdud pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ 'dul ba'i las chog sogs sgrigs su bcug pa'i thugs dam dang / phyi dro yi dam chos skyong la sogs pa'i nang gi gtor ma rgyas par bshams te/ kye rdo rje/ rnal 'byor ma/ gshed dmar/ 'jigs byed/ gur lcam dral/ gdong bzhi pa/ las mgon/ phyag bzhi pa/ phyag drug pa/ tshi ring ma/ tshogs bdag /phyogs skyong bcu/ las gshin/mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sogs gtor bsngo rgyas par mdzad do/ /khyad par thor thun rnams shin du snga bar grub par mdzad/ de nas dkar cha bzhi grol rjes su/ tho rangs 'jam ngo bzhes/ de nas bzung ste mnal cung — 49 —

zad mdzad pa ni 'od gsal gyi ngang nas mdzad cing / de'i dus su 'od gsal 'char ba stobs che ba ni phyag phyi nye 'khor ba sogs kun gyi mthun snang du grub la/ rje nyid kyang tho rengs 'od gsal dang sgrags pa'i mnal 'di chag dogs 'ba' zhig mdzad/ mnal dus su gang zag gzhan gyi ca co'i sgra byas na shin du bka' skyon zhing / da nang gnyid de tha mal bar song / legs pa rang cig ma byung bas de ring khams ma dang gsung ba dang / spyir 'od gsal gyi gzigs snang bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / nangs gcig bka' lung nges pa can phebs pa ni/da nangs tho rengs gi dus/ 'od gsal gyi ngang nas/ dgon pa'i sa phyogs 'di gsal bar mthong / yo byad dngos po dang / dge 'dun rnams ci mdzad gsal bar shes pa cig byung gsung / de dus tshe ci tsam thub kyi lung bstan cig kyang byung gsung kyang / rje 'di nyid thugs zab pas de tsam las mi gsung ngo / /slob ma la gdams ngag 'bogs pa'i dus su yang / 'od gsal 'dzin lugs 'di ltar byed dgos gsung bslab bya dang / 'od gsal gyi bsngags pa kho na mdzad/ khyad par rje 'di nyid sku lus tsog pu'am/ dkyil dkrungs kyi steng nas mnal mdzad pa ma rtogs tha mal pa'i nyal lugs ltar mdzad pa skad cig kyang mi srid pa yin no/ /gzhan yang nyams su len tshul mchog tu mkhas pa ni/ chag med rab tu mang po dag legs par grub 'tshams/rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rdzogs bogs 'don dang bcas pa nyams len chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gyi chig 'gril la rab tu brtson par mdzad pa ni/ rwa rtse sems 'dzin gyi khrid skabs skabs su gsung ngag ge 50 —
