nas 'don pa dang— / khyad par nyin re la 'jigs byed kyi sngags gsum gyi bsnyen pa khri phrag re tsam ji ltar nyung na mdzad/ gang zag gzhan la yang 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob pa la nyams len chig 'gril la gces spras su byed dgos pa yin zhes bka' bstsal ba ni/ /rgya gar kun 'dus grong khyer na/ /mthun rkyen mtshungs pa'i lha mchod gnyis/ /rta gcig gso dang rta brgya gso/ /dang pos 'jigs pa'i dgra las thar /gnyis pas yid brtan thub pa yi/ /rta ma 'byor bas tsab tsob kyi/ /'jigs pa'i dgra las ma thar pa/ /de gnyis dper byas theg mchog gi/skal ldan dbang po yang rab rnams/ /zab mo mchog gi nyams len la/ /chig 'gril man ngag gnad du gces/ /zhes 'di snying gtam gces pa'i tshig /ces dang / gzhan yang paṇa chen 'di nyid chos 'brel zhus pa'i bla ma rnams la lhag par dad pas/ bla ma'i rnam thar 'dzin pa dang / snyan pa sgrogs pa dang / dus mchod 'dzin pa sogs bla ma'i mchod pa kho na la brtson zhing / khyad par dus mchod chen po brgyad ces bya ba ni/ zla ba byung ngo cig gi tshes gcig la kun mkhyen rin po che'i dus mchod rab 'byams shes rab bzang po dang / tshogs la mang ja/ tshes bcu la rje sangs rgyas rin chen pa'i dus mchod/ rnam thar gsol 'debs/ dzo tshes bcu gcig la 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i dus mchod/ rnam thar gsol 'debs dang tshogs la mang ja/ tshes bcu gnyis la rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi dus mchod/ zhus lan gsal ba dang 'khor 'das dbyer med/ tshes bcu bzhi la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras pa'i dus mchod/ rdo rje zhung phyung / tshes bco — 51 —

lnga la chos sku te ru ka chen po'i dus mchod/ snyan rgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang /nyer bdun la mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug rin chen rnam rgyal gyi dus mchod/ bslab gsum ma/ gnam gang la sku zhang kun dga' dbang phyug pa'i dus mchod la/ dus 'khor sdom tshig rnams mdzad do/ /mdor na mnyam rjes thams cad du nyams len chu bo'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la skad cig kyang g.yel ba med par mdzad pa 'di ni ngo mtshar gtam gyi mdzad pa mchog tu gyur pa lags so/ /gnyis pa rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis rjes su bzung ba'i tshul ni/ bdag cag rnams kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rje btsun paṇa chen 'di nyid/ rtsa rgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pas rjes su bzung ba'i grub chen bla na med pa yin kyang thugs shin du zab pas 'di dang 'di'o zhes dngos su gsung ba cig med mod/ 'on kyang 'phros gtam gyi zur la cung zad snang ba dang / sku khams gzi tshul kha yar gyi skabs su gzigs snang byung ba dngos su gsungs pa rnams brjod na/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i rnam thar gyi/ dag pa'i mig ldan gdul bya 'ga' zhig la/ /dpag med rgyal ba'i sku yi snang ba bstan/zhes pa'i 'grel par/ gsung ngag gsung ba'i skabs 'ga' zhig tu/'jam dbyangs chos rje nyid kye rdo rje'i sku'i bkod pa ji lta ba bzhin du bzhengs te/ khrid phral la la gsung ba'i snang ba gang zag 'ga' zhig la shar zer ba thos so zer ba bris pas/ kyai rdo rje'i skur gzigs mkhan de rje 'di nyid yin zhes pa dang / gzhan yang nged grogs mched gsum gyis sgrub pa lung sbyin zhus tshe/ 'o 'jam dbyangs chos rjes mus pa chen — 52 —

po la sgrub pa lung sbyin mus spu'i dus/ sgrub pa dang sgrub pashes gtso bor khyed kyi r+pāstaskapa57sgonabam̐ pa'i bshad nyan byed dgosatsā7yin gsung ba ltar khyed gnyis kyis kyangatrebashad nyan byed dgos pa yin/ nged gyi mi lam du 'chos dbyangs chos rje ga shed dmar gyi skur bzhugs pha la/sgrub pa lung sbyin zhus pas nyams dpag med skyes pha cig byung / de dus su yang bshad pa ngagyis shig tses pa'i lung thob pa yin gsung ba dang / stag lo grwa tshang chusgyubazang du phebs stodus/ rjemodi nyid snyung gzhi babs lci ba cig gis shangs khrag bungasro che ba nyid mtshan grel mar byon/sman dpyad sogs kyi phan pha maphusnang dusarte'ajam dbyangs chos rje dbu sngas su phebs/ gur gyi nag thang chen lhumo bkrag gtor tshogs rgyas pa cig bshams nas thugs dam rgyun ring tsam cig mdzad de/ de rjes rje nyid la gtor dbang bka' bsgo dang bcas pa gnang / dpal ye shes kyi mgon po tshe dang ldan pa 'di nyid nad kha 'di las thar bar gyis shig mi byed na gtor ma mi ster ro gsungs nas sku chos kyi 'og nas sku bzan phud de 'di brod— ma yal ba lus kyi sha la chug la nyol/ ci yang mi to yi gsung byon rjes rje nyid thugs spro zhing bde sing ba cig byung gsung / de dus sku 'khrus dpag tu med pa byung / de'i sang tsha ba snga thon tsamanas phyi dro'i mang ja thunadzi gnyis pa 'dren la khad kyi bar du 'od gsal gyi ngang la bzhugs/ de༄sa sku drung na drung bzakhu ba dang /rje rnga khyu ba/ gzhon nu nor bzang la sogs pa bzhugs pa rnams kyis grongs pa la thag bcad/ skabs zhig tu/ drung sangs phas rje drung btsun pa'i drung du phyin pas grwa pa kha yar la ba/'a lung 'dra snang ba — 53 —

dang thug byung dus/ rje'i zhal nas rab 'byams pa ci 'dug gsung /sku snyel po rang 'a dug lags zhus pas/ kho rang ci mi nyes a to yong gsung gin 'dug pa dang / drung sangs pa'i dgongs pa la a to yong don med bsam pa shar/ slar yang log byon pas/ khong grogs mched rnams sku drung ni gshegs tshar ba ji ltar drag gam zhes pa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus mdzad cing 'dug /phyi dro mang ja'i ja thun gnyis pa zhu la khad yod dus/ rje nyid gzim mal nasartsolegs par bzhengs/ phyag g.yon gyis zhal 'gram skyor/ na mo gu ru/ nga yi bla ma 'jam dbyangs chos rje yin/ /gang shar snang ba'i phyogs 'di la/ /yengs med du ltos dang ang / /zhes mgur ma gsungs pa'i tshe/ rje mnga' khyu ba de nyid har bzhengs te/ de na de na zhes gsung zhing zim khang ur ba ltar 'khrabs byung / gzhon nu nor bzang ngu ba sogs dga' spro che la ya mtshan che bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe rje 'di nyid sngar gzim mal nas bzhengs mi thub ba glo bur du bzhengs thub cing / sku lus dang thugs lhag par bde bas tshim pa sogs yon tan mtha' yas pa byung gsung /'od gsal la bzhugs pa'i dus rje nyid seng khri shin du bzang ba'i steng na bzhugs/ khri rkang bzhi la shing rta 'khor lo byas/ acho tsa ra mang pos rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po la spyan 'dren pa yin zer nas khrid 'gro ba'i snang ba shar/ gzhan yang nad thu ba'i dus su/ jo brtan mang pos kyang rgya gar la gdan 'dren zhu ba yin zer byung / de dus mgon po khro bcu'i srung 'khor 'di cher byas pas bar chad kyi mtshan ma las grol ba yin par 'dug ces gsung zhing / dus phyis kyang mgon po'i — 54 —

srung 'khor la thugs rtsol‘ che bar mdzad/ nyin re la ji ltar nyung kyang sha sa na brgya lhag tsam re'i bzlas pa mdzad/ yang skabs shig tu nged kyi rmi lam du/ nged rta gcig la zhon 'a jam dbyangs chos rjes rta khrid/kun mkhyen chos rje dang / rje gtsang pa sogs bla ma gzhan rnams kyis mtha' bskor/ brag 'phrang shin du dog pa cig la tshar la khad la ma tshar bar legs par thar ba cig byung / de'ang bla ma'i bka' drin la brten nas bar chad kyi mtshan ma las grol ba yin pa 'dug ga/sung pa dang / yang sa bzang du sku snyel tshul bstan pa'i tshe/ 'ga' zhig la rje 'di nyid sham+bha lar spyan 'dren pa yin zer ba'i snang ba shar 'dug /rje nyid la bar chad kyi mtshan ma cung zad byung ba la/ de la dmigs pa'i thugs dam drag tu gnang bas bar chad kyi mtshan ma las grol ba'i ltas bzang po shar gsung ba dang / de dus sku rim la dmigs rje nyid grongs slus byas/ gsol dpon bstan pa dar bzang gis la stod la rje nyid sku gshegs so zhes sgrog pa la phyin/ bsam gtan gling du sleb de ltar bsgrags pas/ sgrub pa mo gu ru bya ba nyams rtogs bzang po byas pa cig yod pa de na re/ rje paṇa chen ma grongs khyed kyi grongs slus byas pa yin par 'dug zer/ de ci yin byas pas/ mi nag po cis nged kyi bug sgor byung nas gu ru zer 'bod kyi 'dug a byas pas/ rje rin po che na re/ da lan gyi shi slus de las rim 'gro che ba dang phan pa ma byung gsung gi 'dug go zer byung zer ba dang / gzhan yang sgrub pa mo des rje paṇa chen 'di nyid lho phyogs la phebs pa gzhan gyis ma bshad bzhin du phebs par rig nas rje paṇa chen lho phyogs la phebs pa yod do ces ge 55 —

smra ba bzhin phebs pa stodu ma byung / de'i rgyu mtshan dris pas/ sgrub pa mo na re/ rje— mi phebs pa'i gong du tshe ring ma 'di bsu bra la 'gro yi 'dug zer ba dang / rje rang gi zhal3sa kyang / nged stod phyogs la 'gro tshe/ tshe ring ma 'di bsu ba la yong ba dang phrin las sgrub pa cig 'dug gsung / gzhan yang sgrub pa mos bltas pas rje 'di nyid 'od gsal la bzhugs pa'i dus gzim mal na 'od kyi phung po cig las gzhan ci yang mi snang ba dang / 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ ma he rwa sngo sang nge bzhugs pa sogs mthong zer ba thos so/ /gzhan yang dgon pa 'di thebs pa'i phyi lo/ sku mnyel tshul bstan pa'i tshe/ lho nas dpon tshang dkon bde ba sogs spyan drangs gsol sman 'phrod sbyor 'bul lugs dang / sku dpyad grangs kha sna phul ba'i tshe/ sku khams shin tu ma bde ba byung / de'i tshe drung sangs pas sku drung du phyin sku khams 'di shin du ma bde ba 'dug lags pas/ nged rang gi grwa tshang 'di la slob dpon gyi bkod bzhag sogs chos 'jig rten gyi zhal bkod cig gnang ba zab lags zhus pas/ nged rang la rmi ltas kyi mtshan ma cig kyang yod pas da lan mi 'chi ba khag theg /de 'dra byed mi dgos gsung / drung 'byor bas kyang sku khams ji 'dra yod mi shes pa 'dug pas/ grwa tshang gi zhal bkod cis kyang gnang dgos lags zhus tshe/ khyed rnams nga la yid mi ches pa 'dug da len de 'dra byed mi dgos/ nga dge slong rgan pa cig gi brdzun bya dogs med/ phyis ltos shig gsung pa dang /ci khyad par skabs cig tu gser ma'i rnam pas 'od gsal gyi ngang la cung zad bzhugs pa yang byung / de dus phyag phyi — 56 —

'khor pa rnams shin du 'tshab pa yang byung 'dug /re zhig na rje nyid kyi zhal nas khong bgres po gnyis po bos shog gamung ba ltar gdanasko 'dren zhus sku mdun du sleb tshe tshe/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ 'o ngarisardo rje'i lus 'di la rlung mnyam rgyu lan gsum byung / gecig mu phazang du byung / gcig sa bzang du byung / da lan dang gsum byung ba yin/de'ang / rlung gnyis mnyam du rgyu na rnal 'byor 'pho re ran/ /zhes 'pho ba byed pa'i dus su 'dug na'ang nged la sngar yang skyon ma byung / da lan yang rlung de thad la rgyus byung bas nga mi—skyon pa 'dug gi gsungs pa'i tshe/ dpon tshang pas phyag grangs mang bar phul nas/ thugs rjes bzung / thugs rjes bzung zhes zhu zhing 'dug zer ba dang / khyad par snyung gzhi babs lci ba cig gi dus su/ thugs nyams shar tshul gsung pa ni 'di skad do/ /na mo gu ru/ bya btang bdag nad babs lci ba cig gis bzung ba'i dus su sems nyams shar tshul/ bya lta ba'i bzhin legs pa/ 'dzum pa'i mdangs gsal ba/ 'gro 'dug gi spyod pa dal ba zhig nga'i mdun na phar 'gro tshul 'gro byed cing 'dzum sag ge dal lab 'dod pa zhig 'dug pas/ khyod gang nas 'ongs/ da gang du 'gro/ming la ci zer/ 'dir don gang yod byas pas/ kho na re/ skye ba thog ma med pya nas gang nas 'ongs kyi rgyus ni nga rang la'ang med/ da nang ni stong gsal nam mkha'i klong nas babs pa yin/ da gang du 'gro yang rgyus med/ nga'i ming la chos sems zer ba yin/ nged spun gsum yod pa'i chosaphyusems rgan pa ni skyes bu dam pa dang dam pa ma yin pa'i rnam dbye nyabyed pa la mkhas pa zhig yin te/ gig can rnams la snying rje — 57 —

nam yang med/ khrel med rnams ni grub na ci yang byed/ /dam pa bsten na 'brel tshad don ldan 'gyur/ /chos sems nga ni dam pa'i rjes su 'jug /ces pa de yin/ chos sems bar pa ni/ gsal rig sems kyi sanas lugs/ rang ngo sprod pa la mkhas pa cig lags te/ de yi cha rgyus ni khyed rang che ba 'dra/ nga ni chos sems gzhon pa khyod rang gi smos 'dris kyi grogs mched cig lags te/ skye bas bar chod nas ngo ma shes 'dug pa/ 'dir ni khyod la nges 'byung gi bsam pas gsal 'debs cig la yong ba yin zer/ 'o na smros dang byas pas/ kyai/ sbyangs pa can gyi mkhas khyod nyon/ /tha snyad tshig gi tshogs la thug pa med/ /bde gshegs sprul pa'i mkhas grub du ma dang / /thugs yid cig tu 'dres pa'i bka' drin thob/ /zab dgu gdams pa'i bcud kyis tshim pa'ang byas/ /da ni snying po'i don la chig 'dril rem/ /zer ro/ /de'i lan smras pa ni/ cis kyang bden no chos sems tshur la nyon/ /sring ba gnyis ldan dben pa'i re sul du/ /da ni snying po'i don la chig 'dril byed/ /byas pas kho na re/ dge slong par spur ma byed da dung nyon/ /btang bkug gnad kyi nyams len mi ldan na/ /dben pa'i ri sul gcan zan gtum po'ang bsten/ /de la ngo mtshar gnas su su zhig byed/ /dben pa bsten tshul sher phyin mdo las gsungs/ /sher phyin zab mo'i mdo la khyod rang mkhas/ /des na lhag bsam rnam dag dran pa'i mdor/ /btang bkug gnas su sre 'pho'i rnal 'byor pa/ /long med rgyud la skye ba'i lcag 'debs kyis/ /ci byas chos su 'gro ba'i nyams len la/ /sem thag da lta bcad na mi legs sam/ /ting kyur zer zhing gang — 58 —

zhig dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa'i ji chiyi sus/ /sbrul gyi gangabar lo mang bye bar gnas byed gyang / — /bden pa 'di mi shes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de/ /lhag pa'i nga rgya〈 rnyed nas4 'dre bar gnas pa yin/ /ting kyur ting kyur zer zhing 'phur song ngo / khya beta nga bdag—gi sems nyams shar tshul rdzogs so/ 4 /zhes gsungs pa sogs nyams kyi snang ba gzigs tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang 'dir de tsam las ma bris so/ /sazhan yang phag lo grwa tshang metsho sgo rnam rgyal gling du dad 'byor phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i chos rje 'jigs med dpal bzang pas spyan drangs te zhabs tog legs par phul dus rje paṇa chen nyid rjes nas gdan 'dren zhus/ 'byon lamagazhung bskor byas 'dul le la spyan 'dren zhus tshe/ bar lam rnams su mchod 'bul gyi phyag rgya bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad kyin 'dug zer/ dbongs mo ar tho phug tu phebs pa dang zhal nas/ de ring chu 'a dus nas 'di'i bar la yong dus/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad mkha' 'gro ma rigs lnga rgyan cha lugs phun sum tshogs pa'i spras pas gang 'dug /'ga' zhig na re khyed 'bod du 'ongs pa yin zer nas 'dug ste/ ngas khas len byas pa med kyi gsung pa dang / yang bya lo lhun grub rab brtan du chos bar phebs dus/ sku bskung tshul cung zad bstan pa'i tshe/ thugs nyams la kun mkhyen yab sras sogs rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams phebs nas thugs spro zhing mcho—da bstod rgya cher phul dus/ 'jam dbyangs chostse rjes dbu ma 'jug pa'i spyi don cig sanang ste bshad nyan gyis gsung pa'i snang ba shar/ da lan khams cung zad ngan kyang wāga' ba mi yong gsung ba — 59 —

dang / kun mkhyen yab sras kyi bstan pa'i sbyin bdag yin snyam pa/ khri dpon stong dpon rgyan cha lugs bzab par byas pa gzi bajid can mang po yang 'dug /de rang nged la mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i sbyin bdag sde pa kha rer+sā'adug pa 'di la lta ba 'dra gsung pa sogs mdor na rje 'di nyid dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi lhas rjes su bzung ba lags so/ /gsum pa bstan srung dam can rgya mtshos phrin las sgrub pa'i tshul ston te/ de'ang rje nyid sku bsnyung tshul bstan pa'i dus rnams su/ sku rims gzhan gang las kyang chos skyong gi gtor sgrub kho na 'gyur che zhing 'phral du sku khams bde tshul bstan pa mngon sum gyis grub cing / 'ga' zhig gis gzim chung gi sgo ru nyal tshe/ do nub ma nyal gsung ba la ma nyan pas zan thebs gsum 'phangs byung zer ba dang / gtor bsngo'i skabs su/ bstan pa'i bya ba chos bshad nyan dang /grwa bu slob la nyer 'tshe med pa'i phrin las bcol ba mdzad pa la brten/dus rgyun du 'chad nyan 'phel zhing / rje 'di nyid la gtad pa'i grwa pa chom rkun sogs nyer 'tshe'i dbang du song ba ni gcig kyang med do/ /khyad par rje nyid la chos skyong rnams 'go zhing gzig/sa snang byung ba ni/rgu rum gyi bse mgon la mjal du phebs pa'i tshe/ 'jigs byed du gzigs pa/ yang skyed lhas kyi mgon khang gzigs pa la phebs dus/sdom thag cig la nas rdog dkar mo lnga star la brgyus sku mdun du babs byung pas/ rten 'brel bzang kho bo la 'di 'dra yod pa cig lags gsung pa dang / yang grwa tshang spyi'i sku rims la drug bcu pa'i gtor bzlog mdzad de/ dbu mdzad pas zor las mdzad/ dge 'dun — 60 —

rnams kyis gtor rgyab la byon pas/ bar lam du gtor ma bam po tsam rgyab gcig bkal nas byung / gzhan yang rten 'brel bzang ba dang bcas bzlog pa legs par grub pa dang sku mdun du slebs tshe/ da lan bzlog pa de shin du legs song / khyed dang phrad pa de su yin gsung /lkog gyur mngon sum du gzigs shing / phrin las srung mas sgrub pa yin/yang snga dus sku bskung tshul cung zad byung ba zhig gi tshe/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i zhal nas/ drungs sangs pa la/ rab 'byams pa 'di dus rgyun du khams zi ba cig yong gi 'dug khyod song la chos rje drung btsun pa la rab 'byams pa na ba'i rgyu rkyen 'di ci yin do nub mtshan lam brtag pa zhig gnang dgos lags zhugashog gsungs pa ltar rje drung btsun pa'i drung du phyin nas zhus tshe/ gsung bcad 'dug na'ang / de ltar byas pa'i chog/ gi brda cig mdzad kyi 'dug /de nas log sang nangs de/ mtshan lam ji ltar byung lags zhus tshe/ kho rang dang 'brel ye med pa cig la tshe ring ma 'di shin du 'khren pa cig 'dug gtor chung re gtong dgos pa 'dug gyis/ de nas legs po yong gsung ba sogs/ mdor na rje 'di nyid kyi phrin las chos skyong srung ma rnams kyis sgrub cing bran du 'khol ba zhig lags so/ /da ni lkog gyur gnas la thogs med du lung bstan mdzad pa'i tshul ston te/ de yang dad gus dang ldan pa'i sbyin bdag 'ga' zhig gi bya ba khag che ba byung tshe/mtshan ltas brtag pa zhus pa'i tshe/ 'di dang 'di'o zhes gsungs pa rnams kho na bzhin thog tu 'babs pa dang / grwa pa 'ga' zhig la 'phral phugs 'di ltar 'byung gi chilung bstan mdzad pa mtha' yas pa ji — 61 —

lta ba bzhin du byung pa dang / chortog ngan rgyu ba sogs 'di ltar 'dug go zhes mngon sum du gzigs shing— lung ston pa dang dgon pa 'di thebs pa'i rjes su btsang khang rgyab phyogs su sku 'chag pa la phebs tshe/ 'dir btsang khang legs pa cig byed dgos/ ma 'ongs pa na rgyal ba byams pa'i sku ngo mtshar che ba gcig 'byon rgyu yin/ de stabs sa stong 'jog lugs byas pa yin gsungs pa ltar/ phyis byams pa'i sku 'di byon pa dang / sku mya ngan las 'da' tshul ston pa'i lo gcig gi sngon rol du/da lo byams khang gcig bzhengs grub pa byed/ de min nga'i ngo la mi thub gsung ba de kho na bzhin byung ba dang / gzhan yang 'bras yul skyed tshal na bzhugs tshe/ dgongs cig nor bu gling du rtogs ldan gzi brjid can zhig sleb song zer ba gsan pa na de'i dgongs rje gtsang pa'i bu chen 'dra yin nam dgongs pa shar/ de nub mtshan lam du/gtsang pa'i bu chen ma yin/ rje dbus smyon yin zer ba cig byung / sang ltar gtang bas de kho na bzhin du 'dug /de nas nged kyi rnga khyu ba btang / rab 'byams pa gcig na re/ gsol ja cig bzhes pa la phebs na khyab bam zhus shog byas pas/ rje'i drung du phyin te de ltar zhus tshe/ da lta rang 'gro gsung de 'phral la phebs byung / nged kyi gsol ja zhu ring la gsung chos kha yar zhus/ de nas 'byon pa'i tshe/ sgar smyon yin nam de rgur cig rgur cig gsung nas byon song bas/ sgar smyon la ma byung / snyug la ru byon brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa ngo mtshar can mdzad pa de yang de'i dus yin gsung / yang chu ser gyi bsnyung gzhi babs lci ba zhig gis lo gsum bzhi tsam bzung ba la brten/ chos grwar phebs tshe/— 62 —

khur nas gdan 'dren zhu ba dang / gshegs bzhugs gnang ba'i tshe 'dul le la gdan ladren zhu dgos pa la/ dus phyis sku khams bzang ba'i dpe rdzol rgyung ba ni/ thugs dam khyad par can gnad du song bas grub pa'icomadzad pa bla na med pa yin cing / spyir yang nad dge sbyor gyi bskul ma yin/ khyad par da lan gyi 'di'i mi skyon gsung ba de kho na bzhin byung ba dang / gzhan yang mngon par shes pa dang ldan phyir/lkog gyur la lung bstan mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni gong du bstan cing 'og tu yang 'chad do/ /da ni lnga pa dag pa'i gdul byacil grub pa'i mtshan ma bstan tshul bye brag tu bshad pa ston te/ de'ang rje 'di nyid nges don zab mo'i nyams len la mchog tu gzhol zhing / skal ldan gyi slob ma bkri ba la yang mkhas pas/ thugs sras nyams rtogs skyes pa bsam gyis mi khyab lags/ de rnams kyi rje nyid yi dam gyi bye brag du ma dang / rdzogs rim kyi ngang la bzhugs pa mthong ba shin du mang zhing / dper mtshon na thugs sras lung risas rgya mtsho rje nyid la lhag par mos shing / nyams rtogs bzang ba'i stobs kyis rje nyid bskyed rim la bzhugs tshe/ gzim mal na 'jigs byed kyi sku ma he'i zhal rwa sngo seng nge yod par gzigs pa dang / rdzogs rim la bzhugs tshe/ gzim mal na 'od kyi gung bu zhig 'dug pa mthong ba dang / dpon slob brtse gdung nang mthun pas/ gzim chung tha dad na yod kyang / rje lnga khyu bas dad pas rdza sdong gling nas/ rje paṇa chen gyi phyogs la nas 'bru'i me tog gtor ba gyang sogs gang la'ang thogs pa med par rje paṇa chen gyi dbu rngas su tsheg sil zer byung ba dang / gzhan yang gang — 63 —

zag 'ga' zhig gis mi lam bzung / rje paṇa chen gyi drung du phyin pas/gzim zung gi sgo na/ phyag phyi ba de phyar ba zhig gyon nas nyal 'dug /de nas gzim chung3 sgo phye bltas pas yi dam gyi skur mthong ngo zhes bya ba la sogs pa dpag tu med pa yod do/ /zab yangs blo chen spyod pa'i chu gter che/ /blo chung bkod mar gnas bcas rang spyod kyis/ /ri mo'i tshad 'jal blun po'i rnam thar yin/ /skal bzang dad pa'i mtsho la ngang pa yi/ /byin rlabs rnam 'phrul gathugs brnyan ci yang 'char/ /rnyog bcas rdzing bur zla gzugs mi snang ba/ /de nyid zla ba'i skyon min rang skyon lags/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan mkha' ltar pha mtha' yas/ /grub pa'i mdzad pa nyin mor byed pa bzhin/ /rnam par mi rtog gdul bya'i don grub kyang / /skal dman rnams la sla ba'i mgon yod min/ da ni bdun pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa sngon du song ba la brten nas/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa phyogs bcur spel ba'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi mdzad pa ni/ bsdu dngos bzhi yi phan bde'i rgyal mtshan can/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /'di la bsdu dngos bzhi yi sgo nas skal ldan rjes su bzung ba'i tshul/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa spel ba'i tshul/ snyan pa dang grags pa la brten nas gangs can chen po rnams kyi 'dud tshul/ nyams len mdzad tshul la brten nas zhing khams 'dzin par dgongs tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ sbyin pa'i g.yab mos legs bos te/ /snyan pa'i tshig gis drangs byas shing / /don spyod pa yi bag phab nas/ /don mthun gros legs gdab par bya/ /zhes pa ltar dang po sbyin pas bsdus pa'i tshul ni/ rgyan las/ byang chub — 64 —

sems dpa' lus dang longs spyod rnams/ /gzhan la mi sbyin pa ni yod min te/ /zhes pa dang mthun par/ rje 'di nyid kyi longs spyod dngos po ji ltar yod pa rnams/ bla ma'i dus mchod/ grwa tshang gi 'jam tshul sogs bltan pa dang sems can gyi ched kho nar gtong ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos dang mthun zhing sku chas bkren pa rnams la lhag par longs spyod kyi bka' drin stsol ba dang / khyad par longs spyod kyi dngos po gang la'ang chags pa med pa 'di ni zang zing gi sbyin pa'i mchog yin zhing / gzhan yang dam pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa dang / mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa sogs sbyin pa'i tshul la 'gran zla dang bral bar bzhugs pa yin/ snyan par smra ba ni/ sbyin pas mgu bar byas pa'i rjes la/ gzhan smin par bya ba'i phyir chos ston par byed cing / gzhan yang ci gsung ba tham sa cad snyan pa dang / yid du 'ong ba kho na gsung ba zhig go /don spyod pa ni/ gzhan chos len du bzhug pa'i phyir thabs sna tshogs kyi dkri bar byed cing / de'ang gdul bya rnams dbang po'i rim pa dang bstun nas dkri ba la shin tu mkhas pa yin no/ /don mthun pa ni/ gzhan dge ba la bzhugs pa'i do na du rang dge ba la 'jug pa yin la/ de'ang thos bsam sgom gsum sogs dge ba'i bya ba la brtson pa ni gzhan las mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ /gnyis pa 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa spel ba'i tshul la/ 'chad pa legs bshad kyi 'dod dgus skal ldan rjes su bzung ba'i tshul/ rtsod pa seng ge'i nga ros log smra tshar bcad pa'i tshul/ rtsom pa nor bu'i phreng bas mkhas rnams dga' ba bskyed pa'i tshulamilo/ /dang po la bshad nyan da 65 da

mdzad tshu4 sbyir bstan pa dang / bstan pa la dgongs pa'i bshad nyan mdzad tshul phye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang— po ni/ rje 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad spyod thams cad theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed kyi ma zin pa'i skabs mi srid cing / nga'i lus srog bstan pa dang sems can la bsngos pa yin gsungs pa ltar/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can la dmigs te/ 'bral mi phod pa'i tshul gyis phan bde sgrub pa'i byams pa dang / sdug bsngal sel ba'i snying rje sngon du 'gro ba can gyi bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed de/lus dang srog la ma chags pa'i gzhan phan kho na lhur len pa'i yon tan la dbang 'byor ba ni kun la mngon du gyur pa yin cing / de'ang rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi bshad nyan gyi sgo nas bstan pa 'dzin dgos pa yin gsu nga ba'i lung bstan cher phebs pa la brten/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi bzhes pa nas bzung ste/ bdun bcu rtsa gnyis bzhes kyi bar lo bzhi bcu rtsa dgu bshad nyan kho na mdzad pa yin/ de'ang phyis dus kyi bshad rgyud pa mtha' dag gi 'byung khungs 'bras yul rdzong dkar skyed mos tshal gyi chos grwar/ chos sbyin lo nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi bar du mdzad de/thugs sras sde snod 'dzin pa grangs las 'das pa bskrun par mdzad/de nas rje paṇa chen 'di nyid dbus kyi zal mo brag na bzhugs tshe/chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba kun dga' rnam rgyal bas/ gtsang stod kyi gdul bya rnams rjes su bzung ba'i slad du phebs dgos pa'i pho nya ba rim par byung ba la brten/ brtse ba chen pos zhal gyi bzhes te/ yos lo hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig la byon nas yar lam sa bzang du phebs — 66 —

zla ba gnyis tsam bzhugs/ der yang gdan 'dren pa byung ba la brten/dpon slob bdun tsam gyis phebs te/ pho brang khyung rtser yon mchod mjal 'phrad legs par mdzad/ de yi tshe rje dpon slob rnams kyis khyung rtser zhag 'ga' bzhugs/ sde bdag dpon blon rnams kyis bsam gling du phebs/ rje nyid mkhan por phebs pa'i sta gon rnams mdzad/de nas skabs su babs tshe/ ser phreng sogs spyan 'dren pa'i rig byed du ma dang bcas legs par spyan drangs te/ bsam gling gi mkhan por mnga' gsol/ de nas dbus gtsang gi sde dpon gzhan rnams la mchod sanas bya bral grwa sa bzhin dag pa 'dug na'ang / la stod kyi phyogs 'di sa khang mthos pa nas sngar phan de 'dra ma byung 'dug na'ang / da lan rje paṇa chen phebs pa thugs rjes bzung zhing / stod phyogs kyi bstan pa dang sems can la dgongs/ bya bral grwa sa phun sum tshogs pa cig 'dzugs pa'i thugs 'dun gnang dgos/ bdag yon bdag rnams kyis kyang mchod gzhis sogs bstan pa'i zhabs tog legs par bgyid lags gsung ba'i zhu ba nan cher phebs pa la brten/rab byung zhes bya me mo yos bu'i lo hor zla bdun pa'i tshes grangs bzang po la 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang byang phyogs dpal gyi ri'i gnas chen du 'khor nyung shas dang bcas btsugs pas/ bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rje dang / dkar phyogs skyong ba'i srung ma khyad par can dang /bye brag tu sku tshe dpag tu med pa nas legs spyad dang smon lam rlabs po ches 'tshams sbyar bas sngon gyi sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po de dag dang tshul mtshungs shing / yangs pa'i rgyal khams tshen po bde bas skyong — 67 —

ba'i tshul la 'gran zla ma mchis pa/ bltan pa stobs kyis 'dzin pa'i rgya byin chen po kun dga' rnam par rgyal ba rab tu brtan pa'i rdo rje dpal bzang po'i bka' drin la brten/ 'brug lo hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gsum gyi bar la shin du chos 'phel zhing bstan pa la phan par byung ba yin gsung / khyad par chos rgyal chen po de rje nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad gus dang / dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs la lhag par mos pa la brten nas gsol phogs lo bskor ma/ gzhan yang bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa mdzad pa'i stabs nas dge 'dun zhal grangs kyang tshogs pa che dus sum brgya tsam byung ba yin no/ /de nas gtso chen sa bzang du bzhus/sa/ lo lnga drug tsam gyi bar la bshad nyan shin du 'phel zhing / gangs ri'i khrod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal ldan sa skya'i gong ma chen po khu dbon rnams kyis brtse ba'i spyan ras kyis 'tsho ba yin gsung / de nas bya lo rje nyid kyi thugs sras shar mdo khams kyi sa'i cha khri skor gsum lhag tsam gyi bdag po chen po rigs bu cho 'brang phun sum tshogs shing bsod nams chen po dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba gling dpon chen ting nge 'dzin 'od zer ba phyag phebs shing / mchod sprin gyi rgya mtsho chen po mngon par dkyil te/ bsnyen bkur dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bstan pa dar rgyas su byung ba yin no/ /gnyis pa ni khyi lo dpon chen drung shar phyogs la phyag phebs pa snga dus/ nged rang gi grwa tshang 'di la gzhis 'jags pa'i dgon pa cig med na bstan pa'i rgyun ring po cig e yong mi shes pas da lta nga rang yod dus dgon pa'i gzhi bzung bdag rkyen sbyar thub pa cig byed gsung / bstan pa'i khur — 68 —

bzhes gtso bor gnang nas tho ga mar rje paṇa chen gyi drung du dgon pa 'debs pa'i lo rgyus mus/ de nas che bgres rnams la'ang zhal brda snang / 'debs bar thugs thag chod pa'i tshe/ rje pan chen la dgon pa 'debs pa'i sa cha'i 'os kha yar 'dug lags pa 'di rnams gang zab do nub mtshan lam brtag pa mdzad dgos lags zhus pa ltar mdzad tshe/rje nyid kyi mtshan lam la da lta dgon pa btab si 'di la nyi ma se thal le shar 'dug pa cig byung / de'i sang nyin bstan pa rinangapo che'i sbyin bdag dad gus phun sum tshogs pas lhag par thugs rgyud mdzes pa'i sde pa mgon po bsam 'grub pa spyan drangs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i zhabs tog la dgongs/ dgon pa 'debs pa'i sa cha 'bul dgos pa'i bka' lung gnang ba na/ sde pa drung gis kyang legs par phul zhing / de nas sa cha la gzigs tog mdzad pa la phebs dus nam zla shin du grang kyang / me tog kha dog legs pa cig skyes 'dug pa rje paṇa chen gyis gzigs pas/ rten 'brel legs gsung pa dang / gzhan yang gzhi bdag de shin du dga' ba'i ltas ston gyi 'dug /khyad par mdun gyi na thang la sa/nas pa'i klu mo de dge ne+ebasnyen du bcug /ming la dpal ldan chos 'phel zer ba yin no gsung / de nas khyi lo hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gsum la dgon pa'i gzhi bzung hor zla bzhi pa la mkhar las gtsugs pas zla ba cig tsam gyi khongs su/ bla brang / 'du khang /grwa pa'i shag mig brgyad bcu tsam dang bcas pa thebs pas shin du bkra shis pa'i ltas sngar chu med pa la rje nyid kyi sgrub chur grags pa 'di thon pa dang / sa rtsi som pa kha yar thon/ sngar mi skye ba'i me tog gsar pa — 69 —

skyes pa dang / gang zag 'ga' zhig la dgon pa btab pa'i sa phyogs 'di mar me shin du grangs mang pos khyab par mthong ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung ba yin/ de nas grwa bu slob dar rgyas che zhing /rigs ldan sprul pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po sa chen po'i gzhi la nye bar 'khor ba'i skye bo mtha' dag la phan bde stsol ba'i rtsa lag tu lham mer bzhugs pa gu ru rat+na bha dra gesod nams dpal bzang po dang / rgyal ba'i bstan pa dad pas mchod cing / yangs pa'i rgyal khams byams pas skyong ba la cig tu dge zhing mchog tu gzhol ba/gnam sa'i bdag mo sku 'bum rgyal mo dang / rgyal phran skar ma lta bu'i phyag bya ba'i 'os su gyur cing / /sngon gyi rgyal ba byams pa'i stobs dang /thams cad sgrol la sogs pa dang dbyer ma mchis pa chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po phyogs las rnam rgyal ba sogs bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mtha' yas pas bsnyen bkur phun gsum tshogs pa dang bcas bshad nyan shin du 'phel bar byung ba yin zhing / de'ang bshad par bya ba'i dam chos ni/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs/ bsdud pa pos bsdus/ grub thob kyis thugs nyams su bzhes pas grol/ mkhas pas bshad nyan gyis gtan la phab/ 'khrul pa zad pa'i lots+tsha ba rnams kyis legs par bsgyur ba'i mdo sde dang / rgyud sde de dag gi dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos rnam dag rnams ni rje 'di nyid kyis bshad par bya ba'i dam chos yin no/ /'chad pa'i tshul yang rgyud sde 'chad pa rnams/ mtha' drug tshul bzhi'am/ rgyan bdun la sogs pa'i skabs phye ste 'chad/ mdo 'chad pa rnams phun sum tshogs pa lngas gleng slangs te 'chad/ bstan — 70 —

bcos 'chad pa na/ 'chad thabs kyi man ngag la sogs pas 'chad cing / de'ang / rgya che the tshom spong ba dang / /bzung 'os de nyid gnyis ston pa/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /ston pa phun tshogs yin zhes bya/ /zhes pa ltar khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'chad la/khyad par chos gang 'chad kyang / thugs thog kho na las gsung ba 'di ni/ 'phags pa gzungs thob pa 'ba' zhig gi spyod yul du snang / rje 'di nyid bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos 'chad pa na/gzhan las ches khyad par du 'phags te/ gsung rab gang dang gang yin pa de'i brjod bya'i gtso bo sdom gyi sgo nas khog phub ste 'chad/tshig gi 'bru snon pa'i tshe/ tshig sdebs legs shing nyan pa po'i blo yul du 'char bde ba/ brjod bya'i don bde blag tu rtogs nus pa/ chos cig lan mang du bshad kyang / snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma zab cing /ngoms mi shes pa chos nyan rnams spro ba dang bcas pa kho na 'byung ngo / /de'ang rgyal ba'i gsung rab gsung tshe/ 'dod gzugs kyi lha rnams kyi me tog gi char 'bebs pa grangs mang bar byung ba 'di ni/ chos gsung tshul rgyal ba'i dgongs pa kho na ltar byung ba'i ltas yin zhing / 'ga' zhig gi phar phyin gsung dus/ me tog stobs che ba babs pa mthong ba dang 'dul ba gsung dus me tog gi char stobs che bar babs pa kho bos kyang mthong la/ gzhan yang de 'dra mthong ba shin du mang ngo / /chos gsung ba'i go rims ni/ thor thun rnams snga thun chug par mdzad nas thor chos gsung pa la khri thog tu phebs/ chos thun lnga drug re gnang / de nas zas kyi rnal 'byor gyis gsol ba mdzad nas/ de ma — 71 ge

thag khri thos/ tu phebs/ chos thun bcu lhag re gnang / de nas gung thun gyi thugs dam rnams mdzad nas gung tshigs grol 'phral chos khrir phebs/ dgongs chos kyang chos thun bcu lhag re gnang / de nas dgongs thun gyi thugs dam rnams mdzad nas/ de 'phral 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su phebs nas/ spyi'i chos spyod rnams dang / de grol nas blo gsal ba rnams la blo mtho dman dang mthun pa'i chos thun gcig gnyis re gnang / slar yang srod thun gyi rim pa la 'jug par mdzad do/ /skabs su gsang sngags kyi chos dang / thugs rtsom mdzad dgos rnams kyang gnang / de ltar bshad pas gangs can gyi ljongs 'di na rje 'di'i gsung gi bdud rtsi la 'khrungs pa'i thugs sras gzhung lugs rab 'byams kyi do shal bzang pos mdzes par byas pa rab 'byams/dka' bcu/ dka' bzhi pa la sogs pa'i mtshan gsol ba dang / ma gsol ba lung rigs kyi yon tan du mas brgyan zhing / rang rang gi gdul bya rgya mtsho'i dbus na yon tan gyi nor bu'i gdeng kas mtho zhing / legs bshad kyi phud sgra sgrogs pa'i bstan 'dzin klu'i dbang po grangs kyi mtha' las 'das pa bzhugs so/ /mdor na shar mdo khams nas nub gu ge mang yul gyi bar byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'di'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal che ba dang dngos slob dang nying slob kyi sgo nas bka' jin chen pos nye bar bskyangs pa sha dag tu gnas pa yin no/ /rje 'di'i bu chen bzang zhing grangs mang ba rnams la bdag lhag par dad mod kyi mtshan rnams yi ges 'jigs pas ma bris so/ /gzhan yang bstan pa la lhag par dgongs pa'i grwa tshang gi chos khrims 'cha' lugs — 72 —

kyi bca' yig chen mo mdzad/ chos bshad nyan 'phral gyi kun spyod mdzad lugs 'di lta bu grwa sa gzhan na yod pa ma yin zhing / nyin zhag khrugs gcig gi chos spyod kyi rim pa la/ gtor ma'i rim pa rnams dang / brtse ba can ma/ mdzad bcu/ bzang spyod/ byams smon/ sgrol ma nyer gcig /sgrol mchod dang bcas pa/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa/mtshan brjod tshar gnyis/ mdo tshar bcu drug /yon tan rgya mtsho ma tshar bzhi/ sku bstod gsum tshar gsum/ chos rgyal ma/ gsung rab ma/kun mkhyen rgyal ba ma/ 'chi med dpal sbyin ma/ rnam rgyal gyi gzungs/phun tshogs rab mdzes ma/ brtan bzhugs/ bstan 'bar ma/ rgyal po sku tshe brtan zhing chab srid rgyas pa'i smon lam sogs mdzad pa 'di tsam gyis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan 'dogs rgya cher mdzad pa lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i ring lugs bla na med/ /legs par bshad pas thub bstan gsal mdzad pa/ /rmad byung rnam thar mchog gyur bsam yas gang / /sa gsum phan bder mdzad pa'i rin chen yin/gnyis pa rtsod pa sengo ge'i nga ros log smra tshar bcad pa'i tshul ston te/ji skad du/ bdag gi mu stegs can gzhan dag /lta ba'i chu las bsgral byas shing / /yang dag lta la bkod gyur pas/ /bdag gi bstan pa 'bar gyur cig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal ba shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la lta grub ngan pa phyin ci log gis bcings pa'i tshang tshing mtha' dag rje 'di'i thal 'gyur dang / rang rgyud kyi rigs pa'i me lce rnon pos bsregs te/ yid ches lung gi chu klung 'bum phrag du ma phab nas/log rtog gi dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs te thub pa'i bstan pa lung rigs — 73 —

kyi sgo nas sgrub pa'i rtsod pa'i bstan bcos mang du mdzad pa'i sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ /kun nas nyin byed phas rgol sa 'dzin rtser/ /rab gsal 'od kyi dra bas khebs pa na/ /dpyod ldan 'dab stong ngo mtshar bzhad pa dang / /de bral rtag can 'khor bcas skyengs pa dang / /lta ngan hūṃ sgra 'byin pa'i u lu ka /nyam thag nyal ba 'di dag 'gran pa bzhin/ /gsum pa rtsom pa nor bu'i phreng bas mkhas rnams dga' ba bskyed pa'i tshul ston te/ spyir rtsom pa'i tshul la/ rab chos dbyings kun 'gro'i bden pa mngon sum gzigs pa/ 'bring lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung ba/ tha ma rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la ma rmongs pa zhig dgos pa las/ rje paṇa chen 'di la ni de thams cad ma lus par mnga' tshul yang bshad cing 'chad pa las rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /de'ang rje 'di nyid bla ma gong ma rnams la lhag par mos pas/ rang gi bka' brgyud kyi mkhas grub chen po gong ma de dag gis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ 'grel bshad rnams kyis phrin las la gnod par 'gyur du dogs nas rang dbang dang gzhan 'grel gyi rtsom pa ni rgya cher ma mdzad la/ 'on kyang gdul byas nan chen gyi gsol ba btab pa de dag gi bsam ngo dang mthun pa'i 'grel pa sogs mdzad pa las/ mdo phyogs la/ rgyas pa 'bum gyi 'chad thabs/ tshom bzhi nyi ma'i 'od zer/ 'dzin thabs gzhon nu rol ba'i sdebs sbyor gyi bcings pa/ mdo bsdud pa'i bsdus don/ sher snying gi ṭik+ka/ phar phyin/sdom rig /mdzod rnams la ṭik+ka re/ 'jug pa'i spyi don/ bsdus don ṭik+ka/ rig gter gyi sbyor ṭi ka sogs sbyor ṭika kha re/ 'dul ba'i khog — 74 —

phub bshad pa dang bcas pa/ 'dul ba'i las chog /byams smon dang /yon tan rgya mtsho ma'i ṭik+ka/ sngags phyogs la 'jam dbyangs chos rje/rje sangs rgyas rin chen pa/ rje gtsang pa gsum la rnam thar re/ gsung ngag rin po che'i khrid yig chen mo/ 'jigs byed brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rwa rtse sems 'dzin gyi khrid yig /sbyin bsreg /drug bcu pa'i gtor chog la sogs pa/ gshed dmar la/ spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/ dkyil 'khor bcu lhag gi dbang gi sdom tshig /gcod khrid sogs mang po dag dang / gzhan yang bla ma so so la bstod pa'i rab byed/ slob ma bu chen so so la gnang ba'i bstod pa/ bka' dang bstan bcos gang go dka' ba'i thad la sdom gyi tshigs bcad/ nyams len gyi gnad bsdus pa'i tshigs bcad sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa cig yod kyang mtha' dag’brjod par ga la nus pas thugs rtsom gyi tho rgyas pa logs su bkod yod pas der lta'o/ /dper mtshon na dus 'ga' zhig gi tshe rje gtsang pas deng sang gangs ri'i ljongs 'di/ bka' gdams pa bya ba se shig ge ba cig gis gang 'dug /de la khungs mi 'dug pas bu khyod rang rtogs ldan cig byas na mi drag gam gsungs pa dang / rje 'dis de bas kyang3gangs can gyi ljongs 'di/ rtogs ldan bya ba 'phongs la lhan pa re brlan/ rtogs pa med la spyod pa rtsing ba skya shig ge ba cig gis d+nghagang 'dug pa sa bdag de 'dra mi byed lags zhus tshe/'o na khyod rtogs ldan mi 'dod pa yin nam gsungs pas/ de 'dod lags zhus pas/ ci 'dra cig 'dod gsungs pa'i tshe/ 'di ltar ro/ /brgyud pa'i bka' babs thor cog la/ mos gus dang dkar chings — 75 —

kyis 'khyud/ /mang du thos pa'i snyan cha 'khrol/ /legs par bshad pa'i mgul rgyan 'khrol/ /tshul khrims dar dkar gos kyis slubs/ /theg mchog sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /seng dhi'i ming can he ru ka /zhes zhus pa'i tshe/ bu de yin no gsung nas thugs dges so gsung pa dang /gzhan yang gdul bya 'ga' zhig la nyams len byed tshul bka' bstsal pa ni/ na mo gu ru/ shes ldan gyi rta pho rgod lags kyang / /gzhan phan gyi 'gros dang mi ldan na/ /byang chub kyi rgyu lam mi chod pas/ /da dung du gdams pa'i zab khyad btsal/ /sems bskyed kyi ral gri dbyibs mdzes kyang / /stong nyid kyi ngar dang mi ldan na/ /bdag 'dzin gyi dgra srog mi chod pas/ /da dung du gdams pa'i zab khyad btsal/ /dka' thub kyi me tog 'phral mdzes kyang / /'dod yon gyi slan dang bral gyur na/ /rnam grol gyi myu gu mi 'khrung bas/ /da dung du gdams pa'i zab khyad btsal/ /'dod yon gyi mtshon rtsi rngams 'thug kyang / /rang grol gyi spyan dang mi ldan na/ /rgyal sras kyi spyan sngar mi mdzes pas/ /da dung du gdams pa'i zab khyad btsal/ /yongs grub kyi mkhar dpe dbyibs legs kyang / /kun shong gi khyon dang mi ldan na/ /'khor 'das kyi dpal 'byor mi rdzogs pas/ /da dung du gdams pa'i zab khyad btsal//blo gtad kyi bla ma mang mi dgos/ /blo gtad kyi bla ma gcig gis chog /gcig tu shes na mang kyang rung / /thams cad bla ma'i rol pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs rje 'di'i glo bur du mdzad pa ni mtha' yas la/de thams cad kyang brjod byed kyi tshig sdebs legs/ brjod bya'i don zab/ gdul bya'i blo yul du go bde/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs — 76 —

pa bzhin du gnas pa yin te/ ji skad du/ dam pa'i chos ni thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ chig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba/ zhes dang / rje btsun gyis/ dad dang dga' dang blo rnams kyis/ /rgyu phyir chos 'di dge ba yin/ /don rnams gnyis ldan bzung sla dang / /yon tan bzhi ldan tshangs spyod ston/ /gzha na dang thun mong ma yin ldan pa dang / /khams gsum nyon mongs rnams spong rdzogs byed dang / /ngo bo nyid dag dri ma dag pa ste/ /tshangs spyod yon tan bzhi ldan yin par 'dod/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /rnam dag sdebs legs rtsom gyi phreng ba yi/ /dbyangs can mgrin par byas pa'i gzhung brgya pa/ /thub bstan gzhi ma chos sde 'o ma'i mtshor/ /zhabs zung ngang pa'i ded daphon gnas bzhin du/ /sa skyong cod pan khri la ngal gso ba'i/ /mgon khyod gangs can bod kyi rgyal po yin/ /legs bshad rin chen gter gyi sgo phye nas/ /gang gi rnam dpyod gser gyi srad bu la/ /nges don nor bu'i phreng ba 'di brgyus te/ /blo gsal bye ba'i mgul pa mdzes phyir dang / /thub bstan gdul bya'i dpal du bya phyir byin/ /gsum pa snyan pa dang grags pa la brten nas gangs can gyi chen po rnams kyi 'dud tshul ni/ rje paṇa chen 'di nyid bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag tu gyur cing byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'di snyan pa dang grags pas legs par khyab pa la brten/'jig rten mchod 'os rnams kyis kyang / rang rang gi gtsug rgyan nor bu'i khri la/ rje paṇa chen 'di'i zhabs zung rnam par rol pa'i bka' drin gyi dga' ston thob pa'i thabs du ma la 'bad cing / de'ang gtso — 77 bhe

bor legs spyad bsod nams kyi mthu rlabs po che'i dpal gyi mngon par mtho ba gnam lha 'khon gyi gdung brgyud 'jam dbyangs mgon po dang dbyer ma mchis pa nam mkha' don grub sangs rgyas tshe brtan bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa dang / bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos la mkhyen rab thogs med du rgyas pa/ gangs can bstan pa'i bdag po bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba sku mched sogs/ bod kha ba can gyi bdag po dpal ldan sa skya pa'i zhal ngo rnams dang / rgya chen chos kyi spyan ldan gling bdag pa ting 'dzin 'od zer ba sogs rab byung gi cha lugs su bzhugs pa grangs mang ba dang / gzhan yang rigs ldan sprul pa'i rgyal po kun dga' rnam rgyal yab sras/ sa skyong mi'i dbang po phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs rigs rus stobs kyi dregs ldan gangs can mchod 'os lha ma'i dbang po kun gyis kyang / so so'i pho brang dang /gdan sa chen po rnams su spyan 'dren pa'i thabs dang / 'bad pa lhur len pa'i brtson pa byas te mchod 'os rgya mtshos mngon par mchod pa sogs rnyed pa dang bkur ste rgya chen po la dbang 'byor par bzhugs pa yin no/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can dang ni 'chi med lam ngogs dag na cher grags pa/ /bde byed rab byung dbyig ldan dbang pos rten dang sbyin byed dmar ser can/ /'jig rten mchod 'os rnams dang ku mud dpal 'phrog gangs ri'i ljongs dag na/ /bsnyen 'os dbang po'i gtsug rgyan khri la gang gi zhabs pad nyer bsten zhus/ /bzhi pa nyams len mdzad tshul la brten nas zhing khams 'dzin par dgongs pa'i — 78 —

tshul ni spyir gang zag rab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi grol/ 'bring de'i steng du dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrungs pas grol/ /tha ma de'i steng du lus so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa zhes bya ba lus la gnad du bsnun pas sems la rtogs pa 'char ba des grol/ des na rgya bod kyi gang zag dam pa rnams/ bla ma kho na'i mos gus dang bkur ste zhabs tog gi grol zhing de nyid la rnal 'byor du mdzad pa yin te/ nā ro pas ti lo pa mnyes pa'i ched du dka' ba mi 'dra ba nyer bzhi spyad pas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa yin/ bod du'ang rje btsun mi las rje mar pa'i zhabs tog tu mkhar sgor mo/ zla gam/ zur gsum la sogs pa mang du rtsigs shing / yang sgyel nas rtsigs pas rgyab rma ru song zhing sgal bug rdol rdol mdzad pas mthar mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa yin/ nged rang dpal ldan sa skya pa'i yang / rje sa chen nyid kyis rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birlu pa'i zhal mngon sum du gzigs nas/ birlu pa/ zhang ston chos 'bar/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po la sosas pa lus ngag yid gsum gyis mnyes par mdzad pas grol ba yin/ sa/ chen gyi slob ma mchog gi dngos rgyub thob pa gsum/ bzod pa thob pa be+edwan la sogs pa'ang bla ma'i— rnal 'byor kho nas grol bar bshad/ khyang rnga ra rje btsun rtse mos/ bla ma kho na'i rnal 'byor dang / zhabs tog gis mchog gi dngos grub brnyes te bde ba can du lus ma spangs par gshegs/ rje btsun grags pas sa chen yab sra55 la lus ngag yid gsum 'bul ba'i zhabs tog dang bla’ma'i rnal 'byor la brtson par mdzad pas da lta 'gran zla dang bral bar brdzugs pa yin/ rje sa skya — 79 —

paṇ+ḍi tas kyang rje btsun rin po che la lus ngag yid gsum rtse cig pa'i sgo nas zhabs tog bsgrubs pas/ dpal ldan bla ma de nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos su gzigs3sa/ gsung rab mtha' dag la blo gros thogs med du 'jug pa dang / mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ rgya bod thams cad kyi skyabs gnas mthar thugs tu bzhugs pa yin/gzhan yang mkhas pa g.yag rong / kun mkhyen yab sras sogs brgyud pa gong ma thams cad bla ma'i rnal 'byor kho na la brten nas grol ba yin/ nged kyis kyang bla ma'i rnam thar dang / dus mchod 'dzin pa/yon tan sgrog pa sogs zhen pho rus che cher byas pa dang / khyad par kun mkhyen yab sras kyi sku'i dri ma/ mi bskyod pa/ rnam snang / mgur lung la sogs pa'ang yid bzhin gyi nor bu thob pa ltar rgyun du byas shing / sku 'da' tshul bstan pa'i tshe na'ang sku sha'i dum bu/ byang sems la sogs pa bzhes pas byin rlab zhugs pa yin no gsung / de'ang kun mkhyen rin po che mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan nas rje 'di nyid kyi gdung mjal la byon pas/ gdung bzhugs pa'i sgo nang na/ mi'i rkang pa'i mthe bong gi dum bu cig 'dug /sku gdung la legs par gzigs pas sku gdung gi zhabs kyi mthe bong ma tshang 'dug pa la brten/ sku gdung gi yin par dgongs te/ tsham tshom med par bzhes pa dang /'jam dbyangs chos rje mya ngan las 'da' tshul ston pa'i tshe/ sku gdung gi drung du bzhugs pa sa skabs shig tu/ sbur zhal dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i ngang nas byang sems dkar dmar dpag tu med pa shangs nas babs byung ba rje nyid kyi phyag tu bzed nas yang yang — 80 —

gsol bas sku lus bde bas khyab cing / thugs nyams 'bar ba sogs yon tan mtha' yas pa byung ba yin no/ /gzhan yang rje 'di nyid chos 'brel tshigs bcad kha yar yod pa'i bla ma nas bzung ste/ bka' drin che ba'i bla ma rnams kyi bar du lhag par mos pa ni/ bla ma de'i mtshan thos pa'i mod la spyan btsum phyag thal mo sbyar dbu 'dud pa sogs gus pa'i rnam 'gyur 'ba' zhig mdzad/ rje 'di nyid paṇa chen yongs rdzogs su gyur kyang sngar ma gsan pa'i chos skor yod na/ ku sa li'am khyim pa'i cha lugs su bzhugs kyang rung / gus pa'i sgo nas bla ma la gsung chos zhu zhing / bla ma la bla mar mdzad pa yin/ de'ang rje btsun skya phyi rin po che la gcod skor la sogs pa'i gsung chos kha yar zhus/phyis skya phyi rin po che gzhis kha rin spungs na bzhugs pa'i tshe mjal du phebs pas/ skya phyi rin po che gron po kha yar dang bcas pa'i bzhugs gral cig 'dug pa dang thug byung na'ang / rgyu mtshan sul tshe/da lta mi mang po 'dug mi skyon na byon gyis/ skyon na 'dirnams thegs 'phral byon gyis/ gsung pa na/ mi skyon par 'dug lags zhus nas byon pas/ skya phyi rin po ches/ rje dpon slobā rnams la gsol ja re gnang / gzhan yang a ru ra 'bigs byed mtshon pa cig phyag tu bzhes/'o gtso bo la ni gsum gsum ste/ /'khor rnamar+sā la ni re re 'o/ khya ba yin pas drung slob dpon pa la gsum phul/ /gzhan rnams la re re 'gyed gsung / gral pa rnams thegs pa dang / rje skya phyi'i zhal nas drung slob dpon pa thugs rjes bzung thugasarjes bzung gda' 'o/ /gzhan rnams ni bla ma sbas nas gdams ngag thobs pha 'di ka mang bar gda' — 81 —

sasungs shin du dges so/ /de'ang rje 'di nyid mkhas grags che zhing /skya phyi rin po che ku sa li'i cha lugs su bzhugs pa de la phyag 'bul gus par mdzad pa la dges pa yin/ gzhan yang nyams len mdzad tshul shin du phun sum tshogs patsāni chos 'brel bzhugs pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mtshan bstod dang / yan lag bdun pa mdor bsdus kyi rjes la spyod 'jug nas bshad pa'i sems bskyed len pa'i cho ga nyin zhag khrugs re la ji ltar nyung kyang tshar lnga tsam re mdzad pa 'di ni/ 'phegs pa 'og ma/ las ches 'das pa bzhan phan gyi zin pa'i nyams len mdzad tshul mchog tu gyur cipa yin zhing / khyad par rje nyid kyi 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs su mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan/ byams pa'i mtshan brgya smon lam rnams gtso bor mdzad pa dang / lhag par nyin zhag khrugs re la ji ltar nyung na'ang byams smon tshar bdun re mdzad pa dang / rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sgrub pa'i tshe/ skye ba phyi ma dga' ldan du skye ba dang /byams pa'i bstan pa shar tshe bstan pa la bya ba byed pa'i rten 'brel sgrig pa yin gsung nas/ ming brje ba'i skabs su ming gi mgor byams pa yod pa re nges par mdzad/ gzhan yang jo bo chen pos rgya gar nas spyan drangs pa'i byams pa mched lnga'i gtso bo rgyal ba byams pa'i sku shin tu byin rlabs che bar grags pa 'di la mchod pa la brtson zhing / lhag par mos pa sogs byams pa la brten pa'i rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa mtha' yas pa 'di ni sku tshe phyi ma dga' ldan du zhing khams bzung nas mtha' yas pa'i sems can la phan pa rlabs po che mdzad pa 'di ni nges pa kho na yin te/ byams smon gyi 'grel pa'i mjug tu/ mi gtsang — 82 —

lus 'di bor bar —gyur ma thag /dga' ldan gnas su rdzus te skye bar shog /skyes ma thag tu sa bcu rab rdzogs nas/ /sprul pas phyogs bcur gzhan don byed par shog /ces dang / gzhan yang spyod lam gyi dus 'ga' zhig gi tshe/ mkhas grub chen po dngos grub dpal 'bar khyod/ /'di nas shi 'phos dga' ldan gnas su 'gro/ /dga' ldan gnas su mi pham drung skyes nas/ /pha rol phyin bcu sngon du 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes bka' bstsal to/ /de'ang bstan pa 'di'i rjes su byams pa'i bstan pa 'byung bas na/ lha gzhan la gsol ba btab pa las/ byams pa la gsol ba btab pa thugs rje myur zhing / rgya bod kyi bla ma gong ma phal che ba'ang dga' ldan na bzhugs par bshad/ khyad par jo bo rje mya ngan las 'da' khar dge bshes ston pa la gsung byon pa ni/ nga ni mi sdod dga' ldan gnas su 'gro/ sbrul gyi lpags pa brjes kyang sbrul mi rje/ /kho bo 'chi tshul bstan kyang a ti sha /de bas dga' ldan gnas der yong bar gyis/ /zhes dang / yang rje btsun red mda' ba mnga' ris gung thang na bzhugs pa'i mtshan lam du/ dga' ldan na rje btsun byams pa'i g.yas phyogs na khri mtho ba gsum bshams/ g.yon na de bas cung dma' ba gsum bshams pa mthong ngo / de'i tshe g.yas phyogs de mdzes par mthong nas de la 'byon par rtsams pas/ gcig na re/ khri de la mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal dpon slob gsum yod/ khyed rang dpon slob gsum —g.yon ma de la bzhugs zer / mnal sad pa na/ kho bo rang gsung rab kyi tshig don dang / lta ba'i go ba bzang bar rlom pa yin kyang / khong pa ngos las lhag par 'dug go zhes tshogs kyi dbus su — 83 —

yang yang gsung bar grags so/ /des na mkhas pa g.yag gzhon gnyis ka'ang dga' ldan na bzhugs pa dang / yang rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan gyis mngon rtogs rgyan yum drug dang sbyar ba'i mdo sbyor mdzad tshe/ sku tshe phyi ma dga' ldan du gshegs pa'i mtshan lam byung zhing / slob ma thugs brtse ba rnams la rang re dpon slob dga' ldan du 'gro'o/ /mkhan chen pa'ang dga' ldan na bzhugs zhes gsung pa dang / kun mkhyen rin po che yang byams pa'i mdzad pa phrin las kho na la mos shing /khyad par jo bo rje dang / rong pa 'gar dge la sogs pa skyes chen du mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sa'i cha/ gzhis kha byams chen gyi gdan sa gnang / byams pa la mchog tu mos pa'i rten 'brel gyis dga' ldan na bzhugs pa dang / rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyang byams pa'i gsung rab la thugs mchog tu gzhol zhing / byams snying rjes thugs rgyud yongs su gang ba'i rten 'brel gyis dga' ldan na bzhugs pa yin te/ rje paṇa chen gyi zhal nas/ kye ma ma ri.ā ldong 'di skye 'chi yi/ /g.yang sar goms pa chas pa 'di bor nas/ /rnam grol grong du 'gro ba'i mig bu khyed/ /ma pham drung du gshegs 'di rigs lags sam/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par bzhugs pa yin no/ /ji skad du/ mnyam bzhas/ srid zhi sawinu kyi rtog dpyod bral/ /rjes thob yul snang sgyu mar nyams su myong / /mnyam rjes bgrod pa cig pa'i nyams len la/ /nges pa gting nas rnyed pa bla ma'i drin/ /gdon 'drer 'dzin gyi rnam rtog dbyings su yal/ /bgesas bar chad kyi tshub ma rang sar zhi/ /sems ma bcos stong pa'i ngang du grol/ /gdon rigs chos skyong du 'gyur ba bla ma'i drin/ /— 84 —

bar —chad dngos grub tu 'gyur ba bla ma'i drin/ /rang sems sangs rgyas su shes pa bla ma'i drin/ /zhes dang / phyi tshogs drug yul snang sna tshogs la/ /nang rgyu ba sems kyi 'dzin pa bral/ /bar snang stong sgyu ma'i rol rtsed kyis/ / nyams gang skyes bde ba'i rol par shar/ /blo chig 'gril thub pa bla ma'i drin/ /zhes bka' stsal to// da ni brgyad pa rtag 'dzinasnyezlog phyirasgrusku 'pho ba bsnyan te/ stsar yang gdul bya'i bsam pa dang mthun par mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa snye bstan nas bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi mdzad pa la/ sku 'pho ba bstan tshul dang / slar yang bstan pa spel tshul lo/ /dang po la 'pho ba bstan pa'i dgos pa lung dang sbyar ba dang /'pho ba bstan tshul dngos bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rje paṇa chen 'di nyid skye ba sprul sku nyidarwa du nges don la gnas pas/ skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag las grol mod/ 'on kyang tha snyad drang don du/mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa'i dgos pa ni/ theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshe/sa gnyen dab / des gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos la dkon pa dang phrad par dku' ba'i 'du shes bskyed cing gus pas 'jug par 'gyur ba dang / dam pa'i chos gzhan dag gi myur du 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / gzhan dag la rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pa la bkur pa mi 'debs shing rjes su yi rang gi dga' spro 'phel ba'i yin te/ gser 'od las/ byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog 'idi snyamarwa soms te/ ston pa shākya thub pa 'di'i sku tshe'i tshad ni lo brgyad bcur nges shing / tshe ring ba'i — 85 —

rgyu ni srog gcod pa spong ba dang / 'tsho ba'i kha zas byin par gsungs la/ ston pa 'di'i bskal pa grangs med par rgyu de dang de la rang gi sha khrag la sogs pa'i lus longs spyod ma lus pa sbyin pa la goms par byas so zhes soms pas the tshom du gyur pa na/ sngon gyi bsod nams kyi mthu las/ phyogs bzhi nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog dang / de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnga sgra bzhi byon pa la the tshom gyi don de zhus pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i sku tshe'i mtha' mi mngon par bstan pa na/ 'o na sku tshe thung ngur bstan pa'i dgos pa ji lta bu zhes zhus pa'i tshe/ bka' bstsal pa/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa de ni snyigs ma rnam pa lnga'i 'jig rten du skye dgu'i che tshad tshe lo brgya thub pa'i dus su bltams nas/ sems can mos pa dman pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba zhan pa dang /dad pa chung ba'i sems can de dag /bdag tu lta ba dang / rtag pa dang / chad par lta ba la sogs pa byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams la phan gdags pa dang / gzhan yang rigs kyi bu mu stegs can rnams yang dag pa'i lta ba la bskyed pas myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de'i sku tshe'i tshad thung bar bstan te/ zhes dang / gzhan yang myang 'das che chung gi mdo las/'di dang tshul mthun par gsungs pa rnams kyang khong du chud par bya'o//gnyis pa la/ ma 'ongs pa lung bstan pa'i tshul/ sku 'pho ba'i ltas shar nas gsol ba gdab pa'i tshul/ dges spro dang bcas nas spro ba bskyed — 86 —

pa'i tshul/ dbyings su thim nas skyo ba bskyed pa'i tshul/ ngo mtshar gyi ltas shar nas dad pa bskyed pa'i tshul/ ye shes kyi gzigs pa 'jug pa'i phyir dgongs rdzogs sgrub pa'i tshul/ nges don la 'pho 'gyur mi mnga' bar bstan nas mya ngan bsal ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rje paṇa chen 'di nyid/ dus gsum rme chags thogs med pa'i mngon par shes pha la dbang 'byor bas sku 'pho ba'i dus la sogs pa skog gyur rnams ji lta ba bzhin gzigs pa ni/ snga sor sku snyel tshul bltan pa'i skabs rnams su sku 'pho tshul mi ston pa'i lung bstan kho na mdzad pa dngaka sku mya ngan las 'da' tshul ston pa la mngon du phyogs pa'i tshe/ lan grangs mang po'i bar du/ da lan nga'i khams 'di gso thub pa mi yong ba 'dug gsung ba'i bka' lung phebs pa dang / khyad par bdag gi nangs cig sku drung du phyin/ sku khams ji ltar yod lags zhus tshe/ khyer kha chen po rang mi 'dug gsung / re shig nas da lan khams 'di gso thub pa rang cig yod rigs mi 'dug pas/ dang du len dgos pas/rje rdo rje 'chang mya ngan las 'da' tshu la ston tshe/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la nga'i phung po 'di ma 'dzogs par me la bsreg thub pa zhig cis kyang gyis ga sung pa ltar/ khyed kyi soms la'ang de kha zhog la phung po 'di bsreg thub pa cig gyis gsung pa'i bka' lung nges pa can phebs pa dngaka phyag phyi 'khor pa rnams la'ang bka' lung de kha bzhin phebs 'dug /gzhan yang skabs shig tu/ kho bo da lo dga' ldan du byams pa'i zla la 'gro/ khyed rnams byams pa'i sku gzugs 'di dang lhan cig tu 'jog pa yinartsogamung pa dang / yang dus — 87 —

'ga' zhig gi tshe/ kho bo da lo rmi ltas cung zad 'gyur 'dug pas nged rang tshos yang kha 'don bsrung 'khor legs par byed cing / bshad nyan 'di bar chad che ba yin pas khyed rang yang kha don rtsol bas thon pa gyis/ khyad par mgon po khro bcu'i bsrung 'khor 'di shin du byin rlabs che zhing / 'jam dbyangs chos rjes kyang nyin re la sha sa na lnga brgya tsam mdzad/ nged kyis kyang brgya lhag re ma chag par byas pas bar chad kyi mtshan ma las grol zhing bshad nyan lam du song ba yin/ khyed rang yang de ltar gyis gsung ba 'di yang brtags na sku 'pho ba'i dus dgongs par gor ma chag go /gnyis pa sku 'pho ba'i ltas shar nas gsol ba btab pa'i tshul ston te/ de'ang rje 'di nyid gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams kyi rtag 'dzin bzlog phyir sku 'pho tshul ston par dgongs te/ dbo'i zla ba'i tshes bcu gcig tsam nas snyel tshul bstan/mar ngo la babs pa na sku mi bde ba'i rnam pa cher song / gsol ba/gsol ja rnams kyang cung zad las mi dgyes/ mtshan la rnal chung ba byung / skabs der sku 'pho ba ston pa'i ltas byung ba ni/ gang zag phal mo ches/ sprin gug mang po yang yang du byung ba mthong ba dang / gang zag 'ga' zhig la rje 'di nyid mkha' spyod du spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya ba yin zer ba rmi zhes thos pa dang / gzhan yang srin bya nyin mo 'byung ba sogs/ ltas ngan pa 'ga' zhig byung ba dang / 'ga' zhig la rje nyid rta mchog rgyan gyis brgyan pa la chibs te mkha' spyod du phebs pa rmi ba dang / gdul bya rab tu mang po la nyi zla rgas pa dang / gza'i bzung ba la sogs pa mtshan ma sna tshogs pa shar ba'i ltas rnams byung bar gyur — 88 —

to/ /de nas spyi bla brang / dge 'dun grwa pa so so rnams nas/ sku'i rim gro la tshogs pa spyi'i snga dro rnam rgyal/ phyi dro mang ja'i thog tu gsung sgrogs chos spyod dang / kha yar gyi yi dam chos skyong la gtor ma phul zhing gsol ba gdab pa sogs rgyun par mdzad/ de 'tshams lha sa nas sde pa tsho byin rlabs zhu zhing mjal ba la phebs byung / yon mchod mjal phrad mdzad/ log phebs dus sku khams bde mo mi 'dug pas sku rims la rtsol ba thon pa gyis gsung ba'i zhal bkod gnang sde ba rang nas kyang / dge 'dun tshogs pa la bsnyen bkur phun sum tshosas pa mdzad/ rnam rgyal sogs sku ṭīms cher bsgrubs shing / gzhan yang gsol sman 'bul ba la sogs pa byas pas nag pa zla ba'i tshes bcu drug gi bar du sku khams phyir ma log tsam byung / bdag gis kyang nyin re bzhi na sku mdun du mjal ba la phyin pas/ gsung gnang lugs sogs kha sang snga ma las cung legs pa cig 'dug /khong phyag phyi ba rnam la dris pas kyang rnal dang gsol ba yang snga ma las cung drag pa 'dug pas da lan dga' rab yong ba 'dra zer ro/ /de nas lho phyogs nas sde pas kyang sku rims sgrub pa'i yo byad dpon tshang pa dang bcas pa gnang byung pa ltar sku rims sgrub lugs sogs legs par phul lo/ /gsum pa dges sgro dang bcas nas spro ba bskyed pa'i tshul ni/ rje 'di nyid mkhas pa rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ kho bo rgya bod kyi gsung rab mtha' dag gi glegs bam gcig pu yin gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge zer ba de kho bo la zer ba yin gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang mi gcig po yi chos gcig — 89 —

po/ /chos gcig po yi go chod po/ —/gsungs nas nyams len gyi gnad gcig tu 'dril ba dang / khyad par lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten/ nyams len chig 'dril du mdzad cing / gdul bya gzhan la'ang khyed rnams skal ba bzang po dang ldan pa yin pas/ bla ma'i zhabs tog la 'bad pa thon/ gsol ba rtse cig tu thob/ dge sbyor gyi gtso bo yin gsung pa dang / yang skabs su spyan nam mkha' la gzigs nas/mchod pa 'bul ba'i phyag rgya dang / thugs kar thal mo sbyor ba sogs mdzad pa ni bla na med pa'i dag snang bsam gyis mi khyab par gor ma chag mod/ 'di dang 'di mi gsung ba ni thugs gting dpag dka' ba dang / dgag dgos gzhan yang yod par dgongs so/ ri /mdor na rje 'di nyid dus dang rnam pa thams cad du bshad nyan la sogs pa thos bsam gyi bya ba yod na yod pas thugs dges spro dang bcas pas mdzad/thos bsam gtso bor mi mdzad pa'i dus nyams len la mchog tu gzhol ba'i sgo nas thugs dges spro dang ldan par mdzad/ sku snyel tshul bstan pa'i skabs su'ang lhag par thugs dges spro 'ba' zhig gi bka' lung gnang ba 'di'ang nang na rtogs pa'i gdeng bsam gyis mi khyab pa cig yod par nges te/ 'chi 'pho la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa mi mnga' ba ni/ sa thob gyur ma thag tu 'jigs pa lnga dang bral/ /zhes sa chen po la zhugs pa'i 'phags pa kho na'i khyad chos su gsungs zhing / 'jigs pa mi mnga' bar ma zad skyed mos tshal bzang po gcig nas gcig tu rtse ba la 'pho ba'i dga' ba la spyod pa lta bur gyur pa ste/ rje btsun gyis 'di yi chos kun sgyu ma lta bu dang / /skye ba skyed mos tshal 'gro ltar — 90 —

rtogs nas/ /'byor pa 'i dus dang rgud pa'i dus na yang / /nyon mongs sdug bsngal dag gi gdung ba med/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de'ang /ji skad du/ 'jig rten spros pa'i bya ba ring du dor/ /dam chos 'o ma bsrub pa'i nying khu ni/ /zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di nyid yin/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bcud kyang 'di nyid yin/ /de bas rgya bod mkhas grub ma lus pa/ /mchog gi go 'phang mthon po der gshegs pa'i/ /gshegs shul bla na med pa'i lam de yin/ /de phyir khyed kyang skal ba dang ldan gyi/ /rnyed dang bkur sti sgrub pas mnyes par gyis/ /zhes bka' phul to/ /bzhi pa dbyings su thim nas skyo ba bskyed pa'i tshul ni/nag pa zla ba'i tshes bcu bdun gyi nyin/ sku khams shin du dwangs pa zhig mdzad/ snga dro'i tshe gsol dpon la/ da nangs tsha bzhes de kha sang las snga ba cig khyer shog gsungs pa bzhin snga mo rang zhus paspu/ 'o de bzang da nangs khyod kyi go chod byung gsungs nas dges/ de nas snga thun gyi sgrigs chags rnams mdzad cing / gung tshigs la babs tshe gsol ba'i rnal 'byor gyi bzhes/ slar yang phyi thu na phyi gtor nang gtor sogs thugs dam sgrigs chag/sa rnams phyi mo rang las mi grol ba zhig yod na'ang / de'i nyin nyi ma dgongs phyed yan la tshar ba gnang /spyir thun 'tshams rnams su yang rwa sems 'dzin gyi nyamaso len bog 'don dang bcas pa dang / 'od gsal phyag chen gyi nyams len gtso bor gnang ba rnams kyang nan cher mdzad/ khyad bar thugs dam kyus ma gnang tshar nas gzim mal du ma phebs bar la rwa rtse sems 'dzin gyi bskyed rim dang / 'od gsal gyi lus gnad yang yang mdzad cing — 91 —

'dug zer/ skabs shig tu da rang 'pho ba'i dus la bab pa 'dra gsungs/ de 'dra dpe med lags zhus pas/ 'o na da lta mngon du 'gyur gyi ltos shig gsungs/ sgrub chen pas thugs dam rnams tshar lags sam zhus pas/ tshar gsungs/ yang de ring sems bskyed du song lags zhus tshe/ sems bskyed tshar mang po grub gsungs/ yang de ring byams smon tshar du song lags zhus pa na/ tshar bdun song gsungs pa dang / yang skabs shig tu nyams len mdzad tshul dang / gus pas 'dud pa'i tshul la sogs pa mdzad cing 'dug zer/ de nas da nga mal du theg gsungs pa'i bka' lung phebs pa ltar du gzims mal du gdan 'dren zhus pas/ der yang 'od gsal gyi dmigs pa sogs cung zad cig gnang / de nas skye rga na 'chi sogs kyi gzhom zhig med pa'i rdo rje'i sku brnyes kyang / gdul bya rnams kyi rtag 'dzin bzlog pa dang / zhing 'di'i legs dpyad kyi mthu zad cing / zhing gzhan gyi gdul bya mtha' yas pa'i 'dzin ma la rnam dkar gyi sa bon btab ste/gzhan phan gyi chu 'dzin las legs bshad kyi char rgyun phab nas sku gsum gyi lo thog skrun pa'i dus la bab par dgongs/ dgung lo bdun bcu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa me mo phag gi lo hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu bdun gyi nyi ma cung zad ma nub pa lha sku dkyil dkrung drang pa cig mdzad/ phyag g.yon mnyam bzhag /g.yas pas sa gnon/ zhal rdo rje 'jigs byed ltar g.yon du zur zhal log ge ba cig gnang / rmad byung ngo mtshar du ma'i ltas dang / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i cho 'phrul gyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pas bsus te kun rdzob gzugs ge 92 —

sku'i snang ba don dam chos sku'i dbyings su thim tshul bstan nas/ rang bzhin nam mkha' spyod kye gnas su gshegs pas mi 'jed 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nyi zla brgya phrag du ma'i 'od kyis gsal mi nus pa'i mun pa chen pos khebs te mog mog por byas/ bdag cag skal ba ngan pa'i gdul bya rnams ma rig pa'i ling thog chen pos mig bdongs/ thar pa'i lam bgrod pa'i mig bu dang bral/ mtho ris kyi lam nas 'degs 'chos te/ ngan song gi g.yang sar 'grim/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi bsten pa'i mkhar ba dang bral/ rnam smin gyi lus zung mi thub pa ltar ni gyur/ tab tob ngag gi smre sngags ni 'byin/ yid kyi ci bya'i rtog dpyod dang ni bral/ bzod thabs med pa'i sdus bsngal ni myong ba'i dus su gyur to/ /kye ma mkha' spyod nub kyi sa 'dzin rtser/ /thub bstan nam mkha'i mdzes byed nub pa na/ /mya ngan mun pas dga' bde'i ri klung non/ /kyi hud gangs ri'i khrod kyi sems can rnams/ /'jigs rung 'khor ba'i g.yang sa 'dir bor nas/ /rnam grol grong du dkri ba'i lam mkhan khyed/ /mi pham drung du gshegs 'di rigs lags sam/ /thub bstan gsal ba'i nyin byed gzhud pa na/ /zer chung srin bu'i 'od ni ji ltar gsal/ /rab rji ri rab rlung gis bskyod byed na/ /rab med rdul phran gang du bde bar gnas/ /snang stong zung 'jug 'ja' tshon lta bu'i sku/ /rgyun du mi gnas yal tshul 'di 'dra na/ /gdos bcas chu shing rul pa lta bu'i lus/ /rkyen ngan me lce 'bar bas cis mi bsreg /e ma chur gnas mdangs ldan pad+ma khyed/ /rgyun du mi gnas mkha' la yal byed na/ /skam sar gnas pa'i me tog mdzes bkra yang / /'chi — 93 —

bdag gshin rje'i tshad pas mi 'jom mam/ /bag yod tshul khrims ldan pa rgyal ba'i sku/ /bar snang glog bzhin mi gnas yal byed na/ /bag med glang chen myos pa lta bu'i lus/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi zhags pas cis mi 'ching / /dga' ldan dam pa chos kyi pho brang na/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po bzhugs/ /gnas der sdug bsngal dag gi nyams thag pa'i/ /drangs bya'i sems can rmu rgod ci 'dra bdog /bdag cag bod khams bor 'di rigs lags sam/ /lnga pa ngo mtshar gyi ltas shar nas dad pa bskyed tshul ni/ de nas sku sa/dung rin po che'i drung phyin te legs par brtags pa na/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ rgyang nas ltas na 'od kyi phung po nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar che zhing lta mi bzod pa snyam byed/ btud de ltas na ba sbu'i bu kha rnams nas 'od skar ma'i 'od ltar gsal la dod cing phro phro byed pa/ gnyer ma sogs kyi rnam pa med pa/ gzhon nu lo brgyad lon pa'i gzhon sha can/ dbyibs 'jigs byed kyi rtsa zhal ltar mchu bgros dod pa/ shangs kyi tog g.yas g.yon gyi bya gshog sa/nyis kyi rtse dang / mkhur rtse rnams zlum zhing khengs pa/ de das/ bi bar 'tshams rnams dang / shangs dkyus khro gnyer cung zad kyi ma/dzes nga / de'ang 'jigs par ltas na 'jigs pa'i rnam pa/ mdzes par ltas na mdzes pa'i rnam par snang ba/ lta bas chog mi shes pa'i ya mtshan can cig tu mthong zhing / bla ma gong ma rnams la'ang de ltar byung ba dang don gcig pa ni rgyud sde'i dgongs pa bla na med pa yin la/ skabs su shangs nas byang sems dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa babs pa yang bsam — 94 —

gyis mi khyab bo/ /tshes nyi shu'i nyin zhal gyi mdangs rnams kyang yal/dbyibs mdzes pa rnams kyang nyams/ nam mkha' la ngo mtshar gyi ltas bkod pa snga ma las mchog tu gyur pa 'dug pa dang bstun na/ nyi shu'i nyin 'od gsal las bzhengs te/ dga' ldan du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bsu ba dang bcas gshegs par gor ma chag mod/ 'on kyang blo chung gi dogs pas/ nyer gnyis kyi phar gdung la phyag phyi 'bul ba sogs ma nus/ de nas legs par phul bas dbu thod lag 'thil tsam cig 'phar/ dbu skra'i rtse zil pas khebs pa cig 'dug /thog mar sde bdag sogs nyung shas kyis byin rlabs zhus/ de nas grwa bu slob phyogs kyi sbyin bdag dad 'byor can rnams kyis sku gdung rin po che'i drung du byin rlabs zhu ba dang / mchod pa 'bul ba'i dus/ nyin re bzhin ngo mtshar rmad du byu—nga ba'i ltas skye bo tha ma/la pa rnams la yang thun mong du gyur pa byung tshul ni/ nam mkha' 'od sna tshogs kyi rnam par bkra ba/ tshon ris mkhas pas ched du bkod pa lta bu'i rgyan gyis legs par spras shing / mchod rdzas kyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang ba dang / res 'ga' ni 'ja' sprin dkar po sha stag srab pa dang / khod snyom pa/ yid 'phrog pas nam mkha'i khams 'di skad cig nyid la khyab par byas te/ rkyang ser la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis mi g.yo bar dar dkar gyi bla re phub pa lta bu rgyun ring du gnas pa dang / res 'ga' ni dgon pa'i rgyab ri dang g.yas kyi ri sna la brgyud de 'ja' dkar po dar dkar gyi yol ba brkyang ba lta bu dang /sku gdung gi thad sor gur phub pa ltar byas/ mdun gyi thad so g.yas — 95 —

g.yon gyi ri sna la thug pa'i mkha' la bdun mang po gral bshibs te/nang du me tog kha dog dkar po dang / dmar po sogs sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkod pa ya mtshan can du gyur pa la/ shar ri thad 'tshams kyi ri sna ci rigs pa nas 'ja' dkar dar thag btang pa dang / dar lam brkyang ba lta bu dang / phyogs 'tshams cig nas cig shos su thal mar sleb pa dang / res 'ga' ni nub dang lho phyogs nas 'ja' tshon kha dog lnga ldan du rgyugs pa las me tog zlum rtsigs byas pa'am/ sman tshe'i dar thag brkyang pa lta bu mdzes shing yid 'phrog pa dang / phal cher nub phyogs nas sku gdung gi rgyab phyogs su dpag bsam ljon pa lta bu'i 'jas 'dud pa dang / nam mkha'i khyon la 'ja'i dbyibs yol ba dang / bla re dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / de bzhin du bum pa bzang po dang / dpal be'u dang / g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung dang / rdo rje dang / dril bu dang / ḍā ma ru dang / kha ṭī ka dang / ṭi shu la dang / nor bu rin po che mi 'dra ba du ma'i dbyibs dang / me ris dang / pun da ri ka la sogs pa'i me tog sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa dang / mchod pa'i lha mo lag na mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa dpag med dang / lha'i tshogs zhi ba dang / drag po dang / zhi ma khro dang /khyad par 'jigs byed dang / las gshin gyi sku gsal la dod pa mthong ba shin du mang ba dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni 'ja' kha dog sna tshogs pa'i gur khyim dang / 'ja' kha dog mi 'dra ba lnga rim la sogs pas bskor zhing / mdzes par spras te/ 'char nub byed pa dang / res 'ga' nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor med kyang sku gdung rin po che'i thad so'i — 96 —

mkha' la 'ja'i gur khyim lta bu'i bskor te gnas pa dang / res 'ga' 'ja' lam dar dkar brkyang pa lta bu sku gdung gi thad sor zug pa grangs mang ba dang / gzhan yang lha'i me tog gi char mngon par babs te/ sa gzhi khebs shing khyad paralke snga dro nyi ma shar 'phral me tog 'bab pa stobs che ba dang / sgra chen po rnam par mi 'tshams pa snyan zhing 'ur la brjid pa lan 'ga' grag nas shar phyogs su yal ba dang / lha rdzas spos kyi dri zhim po rgyun chags su 'thul bas skal bzang dbang po tshim par byed pa dang / gzhan yang rol mo'i bye brag la sogs pa lha mi'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod pa ni/ sku'i snang ba bsdus nas gsol btab ma grub kyi bar ram/ tha mal pa rnams la zhag po zhe dgu zhes grags pa ma grol gyi bar la rgyun mi 'chad du byung zhing / khyad par rje 'di rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la dad gus kyi gdung shugs rab tu che ba'i rten 'brel gyis/ tshes gcig /bcu bzhi/ bco lnga la sogs pa rnams dang / mchod 'bul gyi dngos gzhi rnams kyi dus ni/ sngar bshad pa'i mchod rdzas de dag ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung bas mchod par byed do/ /de dag gi skabs su gsung chos kyi bka' drin nos pa'i dad 'dus rnams dang / phyogs 'di'i skye bo lam gzhung gi rgyu 'grul nga/ rnams kyis kyang ngo mtshar ba'i ltas de rnams ni mthong / slar rje nyid kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa la dad pa ches cher skyes/ bka' drin gyi bdud rtsi'i blo gros kyi bum pa gang bar byas te nyes ltung gi dri ma dag par byas pa ni dran/ phyin chad zab rgyas chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa'i skal bas ni dben/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho — 97 —

sgrol ba'i ded dpon dang bral bas rnam grol nor bu'i gling du phyin pa'i mthu med snyam sems khong du chude par gyur mod/ 'on kyang skabs ci rigs par nam mkha'i cho 'phrul gyi ltas rnams mthong ba'i rkyen byas/sdug bsngal rnams 'gags shing bde ba'i rnam par gyur te/ nyams dga' yal le ba dang / sems spro sing nge bar byas/ la la ni gdong gyen du phyogs te lta bar byed/ kha cig ni phan tshun cig gis cig shos la ston pa'i rtsol ba sna tshogs byed/ 'ga' zhig ni 'gro ba'i tshe yang rang lta ba dang gzhan la ston pa'i phyir ca co'i sgra mang zhing / gom stabs 'khyor bar byed/ mdor na blo gzu por gnas shing rnam dpyod kyi blo gros mi dman pa rnams gangs can gyi khrod du 'das grongs kyi tshul bstan pa'i mkhas grub cig la 'das rtags kyi khyad par ya mtshan che ba'i dper 'os so zhes gtam du byed par gyur to/ /de lta bu'i ltas kyi khyad par rnams ni dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su sku'i bkod pa sna tshogs bstan nas gdul bya mtha' yas pa smin grol gyi lam la 'god par mdzad pa'i nges pa can gyi rtags su bshad de/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ rnal 'byor pa rnams 'pho ba'i tshe/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung mkha' 'gro rnams/ /lag na me tog sna tshogs thogs/ /rgyal mtshan ba dan sna tshogs dang / /rol mo'i sgra ni sna tshogs dang / /sna tshosas glu yi mchod pas mchod/ /'chi ba zhes bya'i rnam rtog 'di/ /mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su khyer/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /drug pa ye shes kyi sazigs pa 'jug phyir dgongs rdzogs sgrub pa'i tshul la/ bsgrubs tshul dngos dang / ya mtshan rten gyi byon tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ spyi bla brang /— 98 —

phyogs kyibyu bla ma slob dzādapon/ grwa bu sbob sbyin bdag dang 'byor can dpag tu med pas/sto nag pa zla ba'i tshes co brgyad nas bzung ste/ zla ba phyed dang gnyisalke tsam gyi bar du/ dge 'dun sum brgya tsam la mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pas rgyun ma chad par mchod pa dang /khyad par bstan pa'i rgya byin chen po phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba yab yum gnyis kyis dgongs rdzogs kyi khur bzhes gtso bor gnang /gdan sa chen por 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dbus la gong ma chen po spyan drangs te/ mchod pa'i sprin phung mtha' yas pas mchod cing /nged rang gi grwa sar yang gzhal du med pa'i mchod pa'i rig byed dpag gi mi lang pa dag gis mchod pa yin la/ skabs der rigs ldan sprul pa'i rgyal po gu ru rat+na bha dra bsod nams dpal bzang po yab yum rnams kyis sku gdung rin po che'i drung du mchod sprin/ dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phun tshogs kyi longs spyod kyi rgya mtsho mngon par bskyil te/ rje btsun bla ma'i zag med dgongs pa bzang po yongs su bskang nas tshad med mkhyen brtse'i spyan zung sgas 'tsho ba dang 'bral ba med pa'i bka' drin zhus pa yin no/ /gzhan yang dpon slob thusas brtse nang mthun pa'i rten 'brel gyis bdag chen ting nge 'dzin 'od zer bas gsol ja 'bul mi rnams kyang slebs ste dgongs rdzogs rgya cher bsgrubs so/ /de dus spyir ja shin du dkon kyang / rje 'di'i thugs rje bla na med pa'i byin rlabs kyis gdan sa chen po'i phyogs 'dir ja shin du 'bol ba byung / de stobs kyis chang rang so so nas mang ja sgrub pa rnams kyang tshegs dang 'bad pa chung dras bar chad med par legs da 99 ——

par grub pa yin no/ /de dag gi skabs su thams cad kyis mgrin cig tu rje btsun dam pa de'i byang sems kyi spyod pa spyad par dgongs pa'i dgongs pa zab mo mthar phyin pa'i smon lam dang / gsol gdab rgya cher bsgrubs pa lags so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sku gdung rin po che la zhug phul ba'i dus su yang nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa dang / me tog gi char la sogs pa gong du bshad pa ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing gdung rus rnams la sku gsung thugs kyi rten byon tshul ni/ shin du ya mtshan pa'i gdung log tu gyur pa mang po zhig dang / kha dog sna lnga tshang ba'i yungs 'bru'i ring bsrel grangs med pa zhig thugs kyi rten du gdung rus dang gdung thal sogs la byon pa dang / theg pa mchog gi sa thob pa'i rtags kyi stong nyid kyi sgra sgrogs pa'i dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba dang / skye med kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i don du āḥgasal la dri ma med pa rnams gsung gi rten du byon pa dang / zhu thigs las 'khrungs pa'i bla ma dang / yi dam gyi sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig sku'i rten du byon pa sogs mdor na ya mtshan rten gyi byon tshul dpag tu med pa byung ba yin no/ /de'ang jo bo rjes/ dbu ma chen por zhugs pa na/ /shi ltas nam mkha' dngas pa yin/ /tshul khrims gtsang la me tog 'bab/ /byang chub sems la ring srel 'dzag /bskyed rim can la lha sku 'byung / /lha yi snga ltas 'ja' 'od yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//ji skad du/ dad gus gdung shugs ldan pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /chos dang zang zing mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /rlabs chen dgongs pa gzhan don mthar phyin pa'i/ /smon lam rnam dag gsol gdab rgya cher — 100 —

sgrub/ /e ma gang gi phrin las bsam mi khyab/ /legs tshogs shar ri nas 'ongs rta ljang can/ /rab gsal 'od kyi dra bas khebs pa las/ /mkha' spyod lhun po'i spo la yol ba na'ang / /thon 'thing dpal 'phrog gos mchog gis klubs shing / /mar gad mdang ldargo skosung rgyas spras pa'i/ /nor 'dzin bu mo rkang drug zlosartsogar rtsed/ mchimakho dbyings la sgyu ma'i rol gar mkhan/ /gser 'od 'khyud pa'i rna cha gdub bskor can/ 5thum rtsen gzhon nu bgrang yas mkha' la lding / /sngon gsags bsod nams brgyas skrun phun tshogs mchog /sna tshogs mdangs ldan rin chen las grub pa'i/ /ya mtshan lha yi me tog sil char 'bebs/ /a dkar du ru ka dang ba la sha /ha ri rke la'i tsan dan dri bsung ldan/ /mtshar du mngar ba'i spo4 mchog dbang thongami 'chi med rnga chen mdo bzhi'i sgra dbyangs can// lke/dung dang cul snyan pi wang ting ting shags/ /dbyangs snyan lha yi rol mo ci yang grag /gsal dngas 'angatā ṇargyas pa'i sngo sangs ma/ /dkar gsal chu shel bye ba'i rgyan phreb can/ /brgya byin gzhu yi gos dkar gyis klubs shing / /sna tshogs tshon brgya'i me tog tshom bu'i spras/ /dwangs gsal 'ja' sprin las grub rgyal ba'i sku/ /rab 'byams zhi khro'i tshogs dang nyer spyad 'os//yid 'ong rin chen bdun dang bkra shis brgyad/ /za 'og dpal 'phrog bla re yol ba dres/ /'phan dang ba dan lda sdi 'phur sding bkram/ /gang zhig byin za'i gzugs la zhen tshe'ang ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul gang / /ji snyed bshad dang bshad las ches mchogayo mar gzhan yang snyem byed cing / /'gag med don mtshon bskyed rim gsal ba'i dpal byin gzi — 101 —

'od rab 'bar ba/ /'jam dpal khros pa'i sku dang mkha' spyod la sogs ya mtshan gsal ba'i sku/ /skye med don mtshon āḥyig 'bur don grag stong bzlas brjod mthar phyin pas/ /snying po'i 'bru tshogs gsal bar byon cing sa thob rtags byed g.yas 'khyil dung / /g.yo med don mtshon zab gsal chos sku'i ngang tshul rab 'tsher mu tig gi /mdangs ldan grangs med ring srel yung 'bru'i tshogs rnams gdul bya'i dpal du byin/ /rgya chen bsod nams bdud rtsi'i zas can las/ /legs par 'ongs pa'i kun mkhyen dmar ser can/ /nyer spyad myur 'gro'i shugs kyis drangs pa las/ /mya ngan mun pas khebs shing sim pa'i tshe/ /e ma ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i rol rtsed ci yang snang bas gang sku dpal 'bar lta bas gdungs shing nyid gsung zab rgyas bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /myang bas rab skom de lta mod kyi thugs rje'i dbyings la rnam par rol byed thos bsam 'dab spras dang ldan rkang drug ldan pa'i mtshor/ /legs bshad pad tshal dri bsung nyams pas zab don ro bcud myang ba'i skabs bral rig pa'i khye'u chung gnam mtha' bskor zhing mchi phreng 'dzag /lang tsho'i dpal ni g.yo ba'i rlung bzhin tshe 'di mi rtag ston ka'i sprin 'dra grogs dag tshong 'dus mgron po ji bzhin lags pa snyam/ /kwa ye grogs dag mi shes sam/ /dam pa'i rang tshul ma dgongs sam/ /rtogs brjod rkyang par mi sems sam/ /dal ba don yod mi mdzad dam/ /pha gsum ldan gyi bla ma rin po che/ /brgyud ldan gyi bla ma byin rlabs can/ /'gro mgon bde gshegs sprul pa'i sku/ /khong ngos cag la bka' drin che ba'i phyir/ /drin lan la 'khor thabs ma — 102 —
