mchis kyang / /dal 'byor gyi tshe zhabs 'di nyid la/ /bde legs kyi'abyung gnas cig pu dang / /'gro drug gi pha ma snying khong du/ /yang yang du bsams pa'i dge sbyor dang / /chos brgyad kyi dri mas ma sbags pa'i/ /thos bsam gyi mchod pa rgya cher 'bul/ /gzhan phan gyi ljon pa rab rgyas te/ /rnam grol gyi 'bras bu 'khrungs par smon/ /r+pādun pa nges don la 'pho 'gyur mi mnga' bar bsten nas mya ngan bsal ba'i tshul ni/ rje paṇa chen 'di nyid thog ma med pa nas tshogs gnyis rlabs po che rdzogs par byas pas/ bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i mchog gi go 'phang brnyes pa la 'chi 'pho ba sogs ga la mnga'/ 'on kyang de ltar ston pa yang thabs kyi khyad par yod de/ rje btsun gyis/ bzo dang skye dang byang chub tshe/ /mya ngan 'das pa rtag ston pa/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku 'di ni/ /rnam par grol ba'i thabs chen po/ /zhes dang /gang zhig gang gi ji ltar 'dul/ /des de de lta nyid du she sa/ /zhes so/ /don rang ngos nas sku tshe'i pha mtha' bzung mi nus te/ gser 'od las/sa la gang dag yod pa yi/ /rab tu phra rdul ji snyed pa/ /thams cad bgrang bar nus srid kyis/ /rgyal ba'i sku tshe'i tshad mi nus/ /'es bshad pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa slar yang bstan pa spel tshul ni/ mtha' bra' chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /de'ang / sas bcas rgyal ba ma lus pa'i mdzad pa dang / rje btsun chen ngo 'di'i mdzad pa gnyis phrin las kun 'gro'i ngo bor gnas pas de dag gi phrin las yul gang la 'jug pa dang / 'o bo ji ltar 'jug pa dang / dus ji srid du 'jug pa sogs ji lta ba dedzisrid du/ rje 'di'i phrin las kyang — 103 —

'jug par nges te/ ji skad du/ rje btsun gyis ji ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /'od zer dpag tu5med 'dres shing / /rtag tu bya ba cig la 'jug /'jig rten la yang snang bar byed/ /de bzhin zag med dbyings na yang / /sangs rgyas dpag tu med 'dres shing / /mdzad pa cig ni mdzad pa la/ /ye shes snang ba mdzad par 'dod/ /dper na nyi ma'i 'od zer cig /byung na 'od zer kun 'byung ba/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas rnams kyi yang / /ye shes 'byung bar shes par bya/ /zhes dang /gzhan yang / sku'i bkod pa mtha' yas pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams mtha' yas par/ gdul bya'i tshogs mtha' yas pa la/ skal pa grangs mtha' yas par chos kyi 'khor lo mtha' yas pa bskor nas/sems can 'khor du ma bsdus pa rnams bsdus/ bsdus pa rnams smin/smin pa rnams grol/ grol ba rnams mthar phyin pa'i go 'phang mchog la bkod/ bkod pa de dag gis kyang mar me gcig la gnyis mched kyi tshul du rje 'di'i phan bde'i phrin las kyang / ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/'bad med lhun grub gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa yin te/ rje btsun gyis/ ji ltar me lce gcig las mar me'i tshogs rab mang / /dpag med grangs med byung yang de la zad pa med/ /ces dang / gang gi srid pa ji srid bar/ /'gro la phan pa sna tshogarme dag /mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni/ /thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad/ /ces dang / ji ltar mkha' la 'jig rten gyi/ /bya ba rgyun mi 'chad par snang / /de bzhin zag med dasdings na yang / /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad/ /ces dang / ji ltar nam mkha'i mthas klas pa'i/ /'gro la rtag tu lhun — 104 —

spub par/ /thogs med blo ldan de yis ni/ /sems can don ni yang dag 'jug /ces gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /da ni gsum pa 'bras bu khyad par can 'byung ba'i ched du smon lam gdab pa ston pa la/ dam pa'i thugs rje la brten nas ma dag pa'i dri ma sbyang bar smon pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten nas rtse cig zab lam sgrub par smon pa/ gsang chen sngags kyi nyams len la brten nas 'bras bu mchog tshe de nyid la thob par smon pa/ 'chi 'pho ba'i tshe dag pa'i snang ba mngon sum mthong nasasazhing khams rnam dag tu skye bar smon pa/ 'gro kun rjes 'dzin gyi phrin las phun sum tshogs par smon pa/ bdag nyid kyi yon tan mtha' med du rgyas par smon pa'o/ /dang po ni/ yab cis/ yab cig rje btsun mi pham mgon/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ bdag sogs deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gsum pa ni/dkyil 'khor rnam bzhi 'dzin ma'i khyon yangs su/ /zhes sog/sa tshirgas bcad gcig gis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa'i tshe/ /zhes sogs tshig/sa bcad gnyis kyis bstan/ / lnga pa ni/ji srid 'khor bar sems can gnalo kyi bar/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad8gcig gis bstan/ drug pa ni/ chu sater gting mtha' nam mkha'i pha mtha' dang / zhasi sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan no//dam pa'i bshes gnyen phar cher zhing gzhan gshegs/ /dam chos tshul bzhin 'chad pa nyin skar tsam/ /dam pa'i rjes su 'jug pa de bas dkon/ /dam pa'i rnam thar bskyangs na mi legs sam/ /'dod ldan — 105 —

phal cher bdag bstod gzhan la dmod/ /blo— ldan phal cher snyan grags gtso bor sgrub/ /mkhas pa phal cher don med tshig la zhen/ /dge sbyong phal cher 'tsho ba'i rjes su 'brang / /kye ma dam pa'i rnam thar su zhig 'dzin/ /mngon du gyur na dga' tshul bar bsngags la/ /lkog tu gyur na rnam pa stong gis dmod/ /gam du gnas na me ltar bsreg byed pa/ /da dus snyigs ma'i sems can 'dul dka' zhing / /sngon gyi rgyal ba mang pos ma thul ba/ /de bas dben par gnas na mi legs sam/ /'on kyang rgyal ba rgyal sras sems dpa' yi/ /dben pa bsten tshul sher phyin mdo las gsungs/ /bsten tshul de ltar byas na cis mi legs/ /dam pa'i rnam thar dam pa de nyid las/ /dad ldan rnams kyi dad pa spel slad du/ /bdag gis sbyar mod bdag ni blo dman phyir/ /nyes pa'i tshogs mchis nyes bral rnams la bshags/ /sang bi rnam thar thun mong mdo tsam brjod/ /dge bas 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i chos spyod 'phel/ /phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi skyabs cig pu/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /ces pa 'di rje nyid las gnang ba thob cing /yongs 'dzin dam pa mnyam med kun dga' dpal bzang po'i zhal mnga' nas bka' gnang cher phebs pa dang / gzhan yang sde snod 'dzin pa 'ga' dang 'gas bskul ba'i ngor/ rang nyid kyi mthong ba rnams kyi steng du/ rje nyid kyi zhabs dring ba sde snod 'dzin pa chen po sangs rgyas grags pa bas kyang legs par bstsal te rje nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos yun ring du bsten ci5 mi phyed pa'i dad gus dang ldan pa'i shākya'i btsun pa byams pa lha btsun grags pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa — 106 —
